6. Repeat until the segment ends, then list the final state.

If the designer has to explain a step aloud, the rule or feedback still has a gap. If the player takes the same action every cycle without reading a new state, the loop may be repetitive labor rather than a meaningful decision. Add a world response that truly changes the next judgment, or narrow the gameplay promise.

heading.zh: 用删除测试找出伪核心系统
heading.en: Use a Deletion Test to Find False Core Systems

body.zh:
逐项假设某系统被删除或自动处理，再问：

- 玩家还需要作出同样的核心判断吗？
- 世界是否仍得到近似结果？
- 后续机会有没有改变？
- 原作或概念承诺的特殊压力还存在吗？

纸城例中，若系统自动选择缺风区，玩家只剩走到风门按一下，分配判断消失；自动清滤网则会删除“现在切风还是先保容量”的取舍。相反，给每个高台加收藏徽章，如果徽章不改变路线、规则或结果，就属于附加内容。首个循环可以先不做它。

删除测试用于控制核心范围。它不能证明留下的循环已经好玩；实际手感、理解和节奏仍要在构建后观察。
body.en:
For each system, imagine deleting or automating it, then ask:

- Does the player still make the same core decision?
- Does the world still reach roughly the same result?
- Do the later opportunities change?
- Does the distinctive pressure promised by the source or concept still exist?

In the Paper City example, automatically selecting the district that lacks wind would leave the player with little more than walking to the gate and pressing a button; the allocation decision disappears. Automatically cleaning the filters would remove the tradeoff between redirecting the wind now and preserving capacity first. By contrast, adding a collectible badge to every upper platform is supplementary content if the badges change no route, rule, or result. The first loop can omit them.

The deletion test controls the scope of the core. It cannot prove that the remaining loop is fun. Feel, comprehension, and pacing still need to be observed after a build exists.

heading.zh: 常见失败与修正
heading.en: Common Failures and Fixes

body.zh:
| 失败 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 只列系统名，没有一轮行动 | 从一个初态走到一个可观察终态 |
| 玩家按键后只有数字上涨 | 说明局面、能力或机会具体改变什么 |
| 世界无论玩家做什么都播放同一剧情 | 让规则读取实际行动并兑现不同状态 |
| 所有动作都算核心 | 删除或自动处理后逐项比较决定是否还存在 |
| 为显得丰富不断增加货币与升级 | 只保留会改变核心判断的系统 |
| 纸面闭环直接写成“玩法已成立” | 标明它是设计，构建与试玩另行验证 |
body.en:
| Failure | Fix |
|---|---|
| Listing system names without describing one cycle of action | Walk from an initial state to an observable final state |
| Showing only a rising number after the player presses a button | State exactly what changes in the situation, ability, or opportunity |
| Playing the same story scene no matter what the player does | Make the rules read the actual action and produce different states |
| Treating every action as core | Remove or automate each one and compare whether the decision still exists |
| Adding currencies and upgrades merely to appear substantial | Keep only systems that change the core decision |
| Calling a paper loop “proven gameplay” | Label it as a design and verify it separately through a build and playtest |

q.zh: 核心循环一定要有资源消耗吗？
q.en: Does a core loop always need to consume a resource?

a.zh: 不用。空间变化、信息获得、人物回应、动作熟练度或机会开放都可以闭合循环。只有资源确实改变行动资格和后果时，才把它放进核心。
a.en: No. Spatial change, information gained, character responses, mastery of an action, or newly available opportunities can all close a loop. Include a resource in the core only when it genuinely changes which actions are available and what consequences they have.

q.zh: 故事游戏也需要核心循环吗？
q.en: Do story games need core loops too?

a.zh: 需要说明玩家怎样反复理解局面、采取行动并看到世界回应。循环可以是调查、交涉或选择，但不能只有连续翻页，而没有玩家介入造成的状态变化。
a.en: Yes. Define how the player repeatedly interprets a situation, takes action, and sees the world respond. The loop may involve investigation, negotiation, or choice, but it cannot consist only of turning pages without any player-driven state change.

text.zh: 在已有 SOURCE_BIBLE.md、选定 CONCEPT.md 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md 的项目中，用 `/game-world-design`（Codex 用 `$game-world-design`）把已选概念写成核心循环：列出动作、规则、状态变化、反馈、下一步与结束标记，并走一条代表路径、做删除测试。只交付设计，不构建游戏，不宣称完成试玩。
text.en: In a project that already has a SOURCE_BIBLE.md, a selected CONCEPT.md, and a PRODUCT_BRIEF.md, use `/game-world-design` (`$game-world-design` in Codex) to turn the chosen concept into a core loop. Define actions, rules, state changes, feedback, the next step, and an end marker; then walk one representative path and run a deletion test. Deliver the design only. Do not build the game or claim that playtesting is complete.

title.zh: 游戏关卡怎么设计：用新决定和规则重组安排节奏
title.en: How to Design Game Levels: Pace Them With New Decisions and Recombined Rules

seo_title.zh: 游戏关卡怎么设计与安排节奏｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Game Level Design: Pace With Decisions and Rules

description.zh: 用进入状态、新决定、世界回应和结束标记组织关卡，让后一段重新使用已学规则，而非重复堆敌人与谜题。
description.en: Plan level pacing with entry states, new decisions, visible responses, and end markers; recombine learned rules instead of adding enemies and puzzles.

answer.zh: 游戏关卡节奏来自玩家判断怎样变化，不只来自敌人更多或时间更紧。先写玩家进入本段时已经会什么，再安排一个新的决定，让空间或局面承载它；结果要产生可见回应和结束标记。后一段再重组旧规则，让默认动作失效、冲突或承担新代价。
answer.en: Game-level pacing comes from changes in the decisions players make, not just from adding enemies or tightening time limits. First note what players know when they enter a segment. Then introduce a new decision and build a space or situation that makes it matter. The outcome should produce a visible response and an observable end marker. In the next segment, recombine earlier rules so the default action fails, conflicts with another demand, or carries a new cost.

heading.zh: 先画关卡路线，再为每一段写新决定
heading.en: Map the Level Route, Then Give Each Segment a New Decision

body.zh:
把关卡拆成玩家能感知的局面，不先套统一段数。每段填写：

| 项目 | 设计问题 |
|---|---|
| 进入状态 | 玩家已经学会什么、持有什么、知道什么 |
| 本段新决定 | 新增的是判断、取舍还是规则组合 |
| 承载局面 | 哪个空间、对阵或限制让决定发生 |
| 玩家动作 | 怎样实际使用已学规则或试出新规则 |
| 世界回应 | 哪个结果变得可见并改变后续 |
| 结束标记 | 什么可观察状态说明本段完成 |
| 下一段重组 | 旧办法将怎样遇到冲突或新条件 |

一段可以教一条规则，也可以检验已经学会的组合。若“新决定”一栏只能写“再做一次”，这一段需要重新设计或删除。
body.en:
Break the level into situations players can perceive instead of forcing every level into the same number of segments. Fill in these fields for each segment:

| Item | Design question |
|---|---|
| Entry state | What have players learned, acquired, or discovered? |
| New decision | Does this segment add a judgment, tradeoff, or rule combination? |
| Supporting situation | What space, encounter, or constraint makes the decision happen? |
| Player action | How do players apply a learned rule or test a new one? |
| World response | What outcome becomes visible and changes what follows? |
| End marker | What observable state shows that the segment is complete? |
| Next recombination | How will an old approach meet a conflict or new condition? |

A segment may teach one rule or test a combination players have already learned. If the only entry you can write under “New decision” is “do it again,” redesign or remove the segment.

heading.zh: 教学段让玩家亲手造成第一项结果
heading.en: Let Players Cause the First Result Themselves

body.zh:
规则说明不能替代行动。第一次出现新规则时，给玩家一个能看见前置、尝试动作、读到结果的局面。失败反馈也要靠近原因，让玩家知道下一次改什么。

教学完成后，下一段不必继续弹同一说明。可以改变空间、目标或同时生效的规则，让玩家主动回忆。重复同一操作但扩大数值，只会延长时间；重组规则才会带来新判断。
body.en:
A rule explanation cannot replace action. When a new rule first appears, give players a situation in which they can see the prerequisite, try the action, and read the result. Keep failure feedback close to its cause so players know what to change next time.

After the teaching segment, the next segment does not need to repeat the same pop-up. Change the space, objective, or rules in effect so players must recall the lesson themselves. Repeating the same action with larger numbers only adds time; recombining rules creates a new decision.

heading.zh: 原创设计示例：影灯剧院的失踪布景
heading.en: Original Design Example: The Shadowlight Theater's Missing Set Piece

body.zh:
以下为纸面关卡设计，没有构建、试玩或节奏测试。虚构游戏中，玩家是影灯剧院的舞台修复员。每盏影灯能把一个纸偶的影子投到幕布上；影子压住幕布上的机关纹路时，对应舞台门会开启。两盏灯同时照到同一纸偶，影子会分叉，门无法识别。玩家可以移动纸偶、开关影灯和拉动幕布轨道。

本关目标是找到失踪的“月舟”布景，并把它送回后台升降台。

| 段落 | 进入状态与新决定 | 局面、回应与结束标记 |
|---|---|---|
| 空台 | 玩家只知道单灯投影；决定纸偶放在哪个标记前 | 移动纸偶并开灯，影子压住圆纹，侧门打开；玩家穿过侧门为结束 |
| 双灯廊 | 已会单灯；新问题是第二盏灯会让影子分叉 | 关掉远灯，或把纸偶移出其中一盏灯的照射范围；影子恢复单一轮廓，轨道锁解除 |
| 移动幕墙 | 已会处理灯光冲突，且上一段已解锁幕布轨道；新问题是幕布会移动，固定位置失效 | 先把纸偶放上固定在幕轨上的平台，再拉动幕布轨道并开近灯；平台随幕同步移动，纸偶与幕布机关纹路保持对位，库房门打开 |
| 返台 | 玩家找到月舟；旧规则与搬运冲突：双手推布景时不能移动纸偶 | 先设置灯和纸偶，再推月舟经过已开启路线；月舟进入升降台并亮起后台编号牌，关卡结束 |

四段没有要求所有项目照用。这里的节奏来自“单灯成立—双灯制造冲突—移动幕墙改变位置关系—搬运限制要求预先安排”。每段都让旧规则以新条件重新出现。
body.en:
The following is a paper level design. It has not been built, playtested, or tested for pacing. In this fictional game, the player is a stage restorer at the Shadowlight Theater. Each shadow lamp projects the silhouette of a paper puppet onto a screen. When the silhouette covers a mechanism pattern on the screen, the corresponding stage door opens. If two lamps illuminate the same puppet at once, its silhouette splits and the door cannot recognize it. The player can move puppets, switch shadow lamps on and off, and pull the screen along its track.

The objective is to find the missing “Moon Boat” set piece and return it to the backstage lift.

| Segment | Entry state and new decision | Situation, response, and end marker |
|---|---|---|
| Empty Stage | The player knows only single-lamp projection and must decide which marker to place the puppet before | Move the puppet and switch on the lamp. Its silhouette covers the circular pattern, opening a side door; the segment ends when the player passes through it |
| Two-Lamp Corridor | The player knows how one lamp works; the new problem is that a second lamp splits the silhouette | Switch off the distant lamp or move the puppet outside one lamp’s beam; the silhouette returns to a single outline and the track lock releases |
| Moving Screen | The player knows how to resolve conflicting lights, and the track was unlocked in the previous segment; now the moving screen makes a fixed position ineffective | Put the puppet on the platform attached to the screen carrier, pull the screen along the track, and switch on the near lamp. The platform moves with the screen, keeping the puppet’s shadow aligned with the mechanism pattern and opening the storeroom door |
| Return to the Stage | The player has found the Moon Boat; an earlier rule now conflicts with transport because both hands are needed to push the set piece, leaving no way to move a puppet | Arrange the lamps and puppets first, then push the Moon Boat along the opened route; when it reaches the lift, the backstage number plate lights up and the level ends |

These four segments do not mechanically use every field in the worksheet. Their pacing comes from this progression: one lamp works, two lamps create a conflict, the moving screen changes the spatial relationship, and the transport constraint demands advance planning. Each segment brings an old rule back under a new condition.

heading.zh: 用默认动作测试识别填充段
heading.en: Use the Default-Action Test to Find Filler

body.zh:
为每段写一个最省心的默认动作，例如一直开近灯、一直走最近门、一直攻击最近目标。然后问：

- 不读取本段新信息也能通过吗？
- 前面学过的规则在这里是否仍会改变结果？
- 失败以后，玩家是否知道默认动作错在哪里？

影灯例的双灯廊如果始终开两盏灯也能开门，分叉规则就没有参与关卡。可以修正规则兑现，也可以删除这段。不要为了阻止默认动作临时叠加无关计时器、敌人和货币；先让本段承诺的规则真正改变机会。
body.en:
Write down the easiest default action for each segment, such as always leaving the near lamp on, always taking the closest door, or always attacking the nearest target. Then ask:

- Can players pass without reading the segment's new information?
- Do rules learned earlier still change the outcome here?
- After failing, will players understand why the default action was wrong?

In the Shadowlight example, if players can open the door in the Two-Lamp Corridor while leaving both lamps on, the splitting rule is not actually part of the level. Fix how the rule affects the outcome or remove the segment. Do not pile on unrelated timers, enemies, or currencies just to block a default action. First make the rule promised by the segment genuinely change the available opportunities.

heading.zh: 让每段结果进入下一段
heading.en: Carry Each Segment's Outcome Into the Next

body.zh:
关卡段落之间需要状态接力。前段打开的门、消耗的工具、改变的关系或获得的理解，应成为下一段进入状态的一部分。

返台段读取的是玩家已经学会的灯光安排，同时新增“双手搬运”的限制；它没有重置成一个无关推箱谜题。月舟送达后，升降台编号牌亮起，是玩家能看见的结束标记。若月舟入台后没有任何变化，玩家无法确认本关是否完成。

线性关卡也可以成立。重点是行动与回响清楚，不必为了显得自由强加分支路线。
body.en:
State must carry from one level segment into the next. A door opened, a tool spent, a relationship changed, or an insight gained in one segment should become part of the next segment's entry state.

The Return to the Stage segment draws on the lighting arrangements players have learned while adding the constraint that carrying requires both hands. It does not reset into an unrelated box-pushing puzzle. After the Moon Boat arrives, the number plate on the lift lights up as a visible end marker. If nothing changes when the set piece enters the lift, players cannot confirm that the level is complete.

A linear level can work. What matters is a clear action and response; do not force branching routes merely to create the appearance of freedom.

heading.zh: 删掉一段，检查它是否有独立作用
heading.en: Remove a Segment to Test Whether It Has a Distinct Purpose

body.zh:
暂时删除某段，直接连接前后：

- 下一段是否仍能理解并完成？
- 被删段是否教会或重组了一条后来会读取的规则？
- 是否有状态、空间或后果因此丢失？

如果完全无损，删掉通常比加奖励更干净。若删除教学段让后段毫无准备，则需要保留一次足够清楚的初次使用；若两段都在做同一判断，合并成一次更完整的局面。纸面路线只说明关卡逻辑，实际操作时长、认知负担和乐趣要在候选版本中观察。
body.en:
Temporarily remove one segment and connect the segments before and after it. Ask:

- Can players still understand and complete the next segment?
- Did the removed segment teach or recombine a rule that a later segment uses?
- Did removing it eliminate a state, space, or consequence?

If nothing is lost, removing the segment is usually cleaner than adding a reward. If deleting a teaching segment leaves players unprepared for what follows, keep one sufficiently clear first use. If two segments ask players to make the same judgment, combine them into one more complete situation. A paper route establishes only the level's logic. Observe actual play time, cognitive load, and enjoyment in candidate builds.

heading.zh: 常见失败与修正
heading.en: Common Problems and Fixes

body.zh:
| 失败 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 每段只增加敌人数值或谜题数量 | 给每段写一项新的判断或规则组合 |
| 教学只弹说明，玩家没有亲手造成结果 | 安排一次动作—回应—结束标记 |
| 新规则用过一次便消失 | 在后段用新条件重新读取它 |
| 删除一段对后文毫无影响 | 合并、删除，或补足真正的状态接力 |
| 为防重复不断增加新系统 | 先重组现有规则、空间和目标 |
| 纸面路线直接宣称节奏流畅 | 标明未试玩，构建后再观察时长与理解 |
body.en:
| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| Each segment only increases enemy values or the number of puzzles | Give each segment a new judgment or rule combination |
| Teaching consists only of a pop-up, so players never cause the result themselves | Arrange an action, response, and end marker |
| A new rule disappears after one use | Bring it back later under a new condition |
| Removing a segment has no effect on anything that follows | Merge or remove it, or add a genuine state handoff |
| New systems keep being added to prevent repetition | Recombine existing rules, spaces, and objectives first |
| A paper route is presented as proof of smooth pacing | State that it is untested, then observe timing and comprehension after building it |

q.zh: 关卡一定要越来越难吗？
q.en: Does a level always have to get harder?

a.zh: 关卡需要带来新的判断或规则组合，难度不必单向上升。收束段可以减少压力，让玩家用已经掌握的规则完成目标并看见结果。
a.en: A level should introduce a new judgment or rule combination, but its difficulty does not have to rise continuously. A closing segment can reduce the pressure and let players use rules they have mastered to complete the objective and see the result.

q.zh: 线性关卡是不是没有选择？
q.en: Does a linear level leave players with no choices?

a.zh: 线性路线仍可要求玩家观察、判断和执行。是否需要多路线由体验承诺决定；单解谜题无需为了形式增加伪分支。
a.en: A linear route can still require players to observe, judge, and act. Whether a level needs multiple routes depends on the intended experience. A puzzle with one solution does not need false branches added for appearances.

text.zh: 在已有 SOURCE_BIBLE.md、选定 CONCEPT.md 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md 的项目中，用 `/game-world-design`（Codex 用 `$game-world-design`）写关卡路线：逐段列进入状态、新决定、玩家动作、世界回应、结束标记和下一段重组，并做默认动作与删除测试。只交付设计，不构建或宣称完成试玩。
text.en: In a project that already has SOURCE_BIBLE.md, a selected CONCEPT.md, and PRODUCT_BRIEF.md, use `/game-world-design` (or `$game-world-design` in Codex) to write a level route. For each segment, list its entry state, new decision, player action, world response, end marker, and the next recombination, then run the default-action and deletion tests. Deliver the design only; do not build it or claim that playtesting is complete.

title.zh: 游戏反馈怎么设计：让玩家看懂动作、结果和下一步
title.en: How to Design Game Feedback Players Can Understand

seo_title.zh: 游戏操作与规则反馈怎么设计｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: How to Design Clear Gameplay Feedback | ZenStory

description.zh: 从行动前条件、输入回应、状态变化、结果原因和下一步机会设计反馈，附原创机械邮局分拣案例。
description.en: Design feedback around pre-action conditions, input responses, state changes, outcomes, and next steps, with an original mechanical post office example.

answer.zh: 游戏反馈要让玩家在行动前看见条件和风险，输入当下知道系统已接收或拒绝，行动后看见具体状态变化、原因与新机会。画面、声音、动作、文字和界面可以分工，重要信息不要只依赖颜色或隐藏数值。数字变化若没有改变玩家动作、世界状态或后续机会，只是读数变化。
answer.en: Game feedback should show players the conditions and risks before they act, tell them immediately whether the system accepted or rejected their input, and reveal the specific state change, reason, and new opportunities afterward. Visuals, sound, animation, text, and UI can divide these jobs, but important information should not depend on color alone or on hidden values. If a number changes without affecting player actions, world state, or later opportunities, it is only a change in the readout.

heading.zh: 按行动前、中、后设计反馈
heading.en: Design Feedback Before, During, and After an Action

body.zh:
反馈不只发生在成功以后。沿一项行动填写：

| 时点 | 玩家需要知道什么 |
|---|---|
| 行动前 | 条件、目标、风险和可判断线索 |
| 输入当下 | 操作被接收、拒绝，还是等待完成 |
| 状态变化 | 哪个位置、物件、关系或机会真的改变 |
| 结果说明 | 为什么产生这个结果，成功到哪一步 |
| 后续机会 | 现在能做什么、不能做什么、该观察哪里 |
| 反馈渠道 | 画面、声音、动作、文字和界面怎样分工 |

反馈要指向规则。只弹“成功”无法说明哪条条件满足；只弹“失败”也无法帮助玩家改变下一次行动。
body.en:
Feedback does not begin only after success. Fill in the following table for a single action:

| Moment | What the player needs to know |
|---|---|
| Before the action | Conditions, objective, risks, and clues the player can evaluate |
| At the moment of input | Whether the input was accepted, rejected, or is still being processed |
| State change | Which position, object, relationship, or opportunity actually changed |
| Outcome explanation | Why this outcome occurred and how much was accomplished |
| Next opportunity | What is now possible or impossible, and where to look next |
| Feedback channel | How visuals, sound, animation, text, and UI divide the work |

Feedback should point back to the rule. A generic “Success” message does not reveal which condition was met, while “Failure” alone does not help the player change the next attempt.

heading.zh: 让不同渠道承担不同信息
heading.en: Give Each Feedback Channel a Distinct Job

body.zh:
同一变化可以有互相补充的信号：

- 物件移动、门开启或角色动作说明世界状态已经改变；
- 声音提示操作接收、方向或危险临近；
- 短文字说明无法只靠画面表达的规则原因；
- 界面保留需要持续读取的状态与机会。

重要结果要有冗余路径。颜色可帮助区分，但不能成为唯一渠道；看不见调试数值的玩家，也要能从实际画面或声音判断。渠道越多也未必越清楚，同一时刻重复播放数字、闪光、弹窗和长说明，会争夺注意。先给每项信息一个主渠道，再补真正需要的辅助信号。
body.en:
A single change can use complementary signals:

- An object moving, a door opening, or a character animation can show that the world state has changed.
- Sound can indicate that an input was accepted, signal direction, or warn of approaching danger.
- Brief text can explain a rule-based cause that visuals alone cannot convey.
- The UI can preserve states and opportunities that players need to read continuously.

Important outcomes need a redundant path. Color can help distinguish information, but it should not be the only channel. Players who cannot see debug values must still be able to judge the result through the actual visuals or sound. More channels do not automatically make feedback clearer: numbers, flashes, pop-ups, and long explanations presented together compete for attention. Assign each piece of information a primary channel, then add only the supporting signals it truly needs.

heading.zh: 原创设计示例：机械邮局的错向包裹
heading.en: Original Design Example: A Misdirected Package at a Mechanical Post Office

body.zh:
以下为纸面设计，没有构建、试玩或可理解性测试。虚构游戏里，玩家在机械邮局分拣夜班包裹。每个包裹有目的地区印章和一枚处理符号：月牙表示只能走低速管，三角表示低速或高速管道都可走，但目的方向仍由印章决定；每条管道入口都标有“低速”或“高速”。北管正在检修时，带北区印章的包裹必须先进入暂存架，不能改送其他方向。玩家通过拉杆选择管道，再按下发件踏板；系统会在发件前检查目的地、检修状态和速度条件。

本例处理一个“北区 + 月牙”包裹，北管处于检修。

| 时点 | 设计反馈 |
|---|---|
| 行动前 | 包裹北区印章在观察框内；各管口标有方向与速度，北管标明低速和检修中，月牙图例说明只能走低速管 |
| 拉错杆 | 西管挡板移动，但包裹台上的方向刻盘仍指北；管口发出两下回弹声，踏板保持锁定，包裹留在主台，踏板旁出现“目的地不符”短句 |
| 拉北管 | 北管拉杆停在半程并弹回，检修牌轻摆；发件踏板仍锁定，文字说明“北管检修，先暂存” |
| 拉暂存架 | 侧轨对准，机械臂抬起包裹；刻盘由“待处理”翻到“已暂存” |
| 结果 | 暂存架对应格亮起编号，北管检修牌登记同号；检修结束后，玩家按号取回这件北区包裹，重新从北管发件 |
| 下一步 | 主台空出，下一个包裹进入；玩家可以先处理其他方向，也能查看暂存架容量 |

误选西管后，系统展示“包裹目的地是北区、所选管道是西向”的冲突；发件踏板仍锁定，包裹留在主台，玩家可以改选暂存架。暂存成功后，包裹位置、格位编号与检修后的处理路径均清楚可读。
body.en:
The following is a paper design. It has not been built, playtested, or tested for comprehension. In this fictional game, the player sorts packages during a night shift at a mechanical post office. Each package carries a destination stamp and a handling symbol: a crescent means it can use only a Slow tube, while a triangle can use either a Slow or Fast tube. The destination stamp still determines direction, and every tube entrance is visibly labeled Slow or Fast. When the North tube is under repair, North-bound packages must first go onto a holding rack; they cannot be rerouted to another district. The player selects a tube with a lever, then presses the dispatch pedal. Before dispatch, the system checks destination, repair status, and speed compatibility.

This example handles a “North District + Crescent” package while the north tube is under repair.

| Moment | Designed feedback |
|---|---|
| Before the action | The North District stamp sits inside an inspection frame; each tube entrance shows its direction and speed class, while the North tube is labeled slow and under repair. A legend beside the crescent says “slow tube only.” |
| Pulling the wrong lever | The west-tube gate moves, but the direction dial on the package station still points north; the tube opening produces two rebound sounds, the dispatch pedal stays locked, and “Destination mismatch” appears beside the pedal. The package remains at the station. |
| Pulling the north-tube lever | The lever stops halfway and springs back while the repair sign sways slightly; the dispatch pedal stays locked, and text reads, “North tube under repair. Hold package first.” |
| Selecting the holding rack | The side rail aligns and the mechanical arm lifts the package; the dial flips from “Pending” to “Held” |
| Outcome | The matching rack slot lights up with a number, and the same number appears on the North tube’s repair sign. After repairs end, the player retrieves this North-bound package by its number and dispatches it through the North tube |
| Next step | The main station clears and the next package arrives; the player can process another destination or check the holding rack’s capacity |

If the player selects the west tube for a North-bound package, the system shows the mismatch between the package’s north destination and the westbound tube. The dispatch pedal stays locked, so the package remains at the station and the player can choose the holding rack instead. Once held, the package’s position, slot number, and later North-tube processing path are all visible.

heading.zh: 隐藏状态不能直接充当玩家反馈
heading.en: Hidden State Is Not Player Feedback

body.zh:
设计稿可能记录拥堵值、警戒值或规则阶段，实现里也可能有内部变量。玩家若看不到与它对应的现象，就不能据此作出判断。

机械邮局可以内部记录北管维修进度，但玩家侧需要检修牌、机械声变化或公开时刻表中的至少一种可读信号。直接显示精确内部数值也不总合适；反馈应符合玩家身份和游戏表达。关键是玩家能根据它决定下一步，而非设计者知道变量已经变化。
body.en:
A design document may track congestion, alert level, or a rule phase, and the implementation may contain internal variables. If players cannot perceive a corresponding effect, they cannot use that state to make a decision.

The mechanical post office can track the north tube’s repair progress internally, but players need at least one readable signal: the repair sign, a change in the machinery’s sound, or a public timetable. Showing an exact internal value is not always appropriate either. Feedback should fit the player’s role and the game’s mode of expression. What matters is that the player can use it to decide what to do next, not that the designer knows a variable changed.

heading.zh: 结果反馈要解释到可行动的程度
heading.en: Explain Outcomes Until the Player Can Act

body.zh:
失败说明聚焦最近一次可改变的关系：

- 条件不满足：缺的是哪项可见条件；
- 输入不完整：还需要选择、保持或确认什么；
- 状态已改变：原动作为什么不能再次执行；
- 结果较弱：完成了什么，又失去了什么机会。

不要泄露玩家尚未发现的完整答案。解谜里可以指出输入未被接受，并让环境显示矛盾；无需直接弹出正确操作。反馈的目标是让玩家形成下一次判断。
body.en:
When explaining failure, focus on the nearest relationship the player can change:

- Unmet condition: identify the visible condition that is missing.
- Incomplete input: show what still needs to be selected, held, or confirmed.
- Changed state: explain why the original action can no longer be performed.
- Weaker outcome: show what was completed and which opportunity was lost.

Do not reveal a complete answer the player has not discovered. In a puzzle, the game can indicate that an input was rejected and let the environment expose the contradiction; it does not need to display the correct action outright. The goal of feedback is to help the player form the next judgment.

heading.zh: 用相邻路径检查反馈是否诚实
heading.en: Compare Adjacent Paths to Check Whether Feedback Is Honest

body.zh:
在纸面上并排写三条路径：满足条件、缺少一个条件、状态已经改变后重复输入。比较每条的操作接收、世界变化、说明文字和下一步。

若三条都显示同一句“完成”，反馈掩盖了规则差异；若失败路径展示成功动画但内部没有提交结果，画面与状态矛盾；若成功后仍提示可以重复领取，后续机会写错。

纸面检查能暴露明显缺口。玩家是否真的注意、理解和信任这些信号，需要在实际候选中观察，不能从表格推断。
body.en:
On paper, place three paths side by side: one in which the condition is met, one missing a single condition, and one that repeats the input after the state has already changed. Compare input acceptance, changes in the world, explanatory text, and the next step across all three.

If every path displays the same “Complete” message, the feedback hides the rule differences. If a failed path plays a success animation without committing the result internally, the visuals contradict the state. If the game still says a reward can be claimed after success, it misrepresents the next opportunity.

A paper review can expose obvious gaps. Whether players actually notice, understand, and trust these signals must be observed in a real candidate; it cannot be inferred from the table.

heading.zh: 常见反馈问题与修正
heading.en: Common Feedback Problems and Fixes

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 输入后毫无回应，只等最终结算 | 当下说明接收、拒绝或进行中 |
| 成功只表现为数字上涨 | 展示世界事实与新机会如何改变 |
| 失败只写“条件不足” | 点明玩家能看到且可改变的条件 |
| 关键威胁只用一种颜色 | 增加形状、动作、声音或文字等可读渠道 |
| 调试面板有数值就当玩家知道 | 给玩家身份内能观察到的信号 |
| 反馈直接告诉谜题答案 | 说明矛盾与规则结果，保留需要判断的部分 |
body.en:
| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| No response after input; the player must wait for final resolution | Immediately show whether the input was accepted, rejected, or is in progress |
| Success appears only as a higher number | Show how facts in the world and new opportunities changed |
| Failure says only “Conditions not met” | Identify a condition the player can see and change |
| A critical threat uses only one color | Add readable channels such as shape, animation, sound, or text |
| A value exists in the debug panel, so the player is assumed to know it | Provide a signal the player can observe within their role |
| Feedback gives away the puzzle answer | Explain the contradiction and rule outcome while preserving what the player must still judge |

q.zh: 游戏反馈越多越好吗？
q.en: Is more game feedback always better?

a.zh: 不是。每项信息先确定主渠道，再补必要冗余。多个弹窗、声音和动画同时重复同一事实，会挡住真正需要观察的状态变化。
a.en: No. Give each piece of information a primary channel, then add only the necessary redundancy. Multiple pop-ups, sounds, and animations repeating the same fact at once can obscure the state change players actually need to observe.

q.zh: 失败时可以只显示“再试一次”吗？
q.en: Can failure feedback say only “Try again”?

a.zh: 玩家已经能从画面和规则读出原因时可以简短；原因不可见时，要指出最近一次可改变的条件或动作，让重试有依据。
a.en: It can be brief when players can already read the cause from the visuals and rules. When the cause is not visible, identify the nearest condition or action they can change so the retry has a basis.

text.zh: 在已有 SOURCE_BIBLE.md、选定 CONCEPT.md 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md 的项目中，用 `/game-world-design`（Codex 用 `$game-world-design`）为核心规则写行动前条件、输入回应、状态变化、结果原因、下一步机会与反馈渠道，并对照成功、缺条件和重复输入三条路径。只交付设计，不构建游戏或宣称玩家已经理解。
text.en: In a project that already has SOURCE_BIBLE.md, a selected CONCEPT.md, and PRODUCT_BRIEF.md, use `/game-world-design` (`$game-world-design` in Codex) to document the core rule’s pre-action conditions, input response, state change, reason for the outcome, next opportunities, and feedback channels. Compare three paths: success, a missing condition, and repeated input. Deliver the design only; do not build the game or claim that players already understand it.

title.zh: 游戏失败与重开怎么设计：写清原因、保留内容和恢复位置
title.en: How to Design Game Failure and Restarts

seo_title.zh: 游戏失败与重开怎么设计｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: How to Design Game Failure and Restarts | ZenStory

description.zh: 区分硬失败、软失败和较弱结果，写清失败原因、保留与失去的状态、恢复位置和重开初态。
description.en: Distinguish hard failure, soft failure, and weaker outcomes. Define what is lost or preserved, where play resumes, and the state restored on restart.

answer.zh: 游戏失败设计要先写可观察的触发和玩家能理解的原因，再决定哪些结果已经成立、哪些内容失去、哪些必须保留，以及从当前动作、本段开头还是整局初态重试。重开后的空间、资源、事件历史和随机条件要明确；恢复路径还要告诉玩家下一次能改变什么。
answer.en: To design failure in a game, first write an observable trigger and a cause the player can understand. Then decide which outcomes have already taken effect, what is lost, what must be preserved, and whether the retry begins from the current action, the start of the segment, or the initial state of the full run. Define the space, resources, event history, and random conditions after a restart, and make the recovery path show what the player can change next.

heading.zh: 先区分失败、软失败和较弱结果
heading.en: First Distinguish Hard Failure, Soft Failure, and Weaker Outcomes

body.zh:
三类结果承担不同任务，只按项目需要使用：

- **硬失败**：本轮无法继续，进入明确的恢复或重开。
- **软失败**：某项目标、未封存所得或局部机会丢失，主进程继续。
- **较弱结果**：玩家完成了目标，但带回的证据、关系或收益较少；它仍是有效终态。

不要把所有不完美结果都叫失败。玩家主动撤退并保住已完成内容，可能是较弱结果；遗漏可选目标也可能只是路径差异。分类要对应真实状态和后续机会。
body.en:
The three result types serve different purposes. Use only the ones the project needs:

- **Hard failure**: The current run cannot continue and enters an explicit recovery or restart.
- **Soft failure**: A goal, an uncommitted gain, or a local opportunity is lost, while the main progression continues.
- **Weaker outcome**: The player completes the goal but returns with less evidence, fewer relationships, or a smaller reward. It is still a valid terminal state.

Do not call every imperfect outcome a failure. A player who deliberately withdraws while preserving completed content may have reached a weaker outcome; missing an optional objective may simply be a path variation. The classification should match the actual state and the opportunities that remain.

heading.zh: 填写一张失败与重开卡
heading.en: Fill Out a Failure and Restart Card

body.zh:
| 项目 | 要写清的内容 |
|---|---|
| 失败触发 | 哪个可观察条件让本段结束或进入恢复 |
| 可读原因 | 玩家如何知道最近一次可改变的动作或关系 |
| 已完成结果 | 哪些事实、奖励、关系或进度已经成立 |
| 失去内容 | 什么丢失，为什么与失败原因相关 |
| 保留内容 | 什么不会回退，避免抹掉已完成行动 |
| 重试位置 | 当前动作、当前局面、本段开头或整局初态 |
| 定义初态 | 重开后的地点、工具、事件历史与随机条件 |
| 恢复路径 | 下一次能改变什么，而非只重复惩罚 |

保留与失去要有因果。一次局部失误若清空无关章节，玩家很难从失败中学习；自动补回所有代价又会让规则失去意义。
body.en:
| Item | What to define |
|---|---|
| Failure trigger | Which observable condition ends this segment or initiates recovery |
| Readable cause | How the player can identify the most recent action or relationship they could have changed |
| Completed outcomes | Which facts, rewards, relationships, or progress have already taken effect |
| Lost content | What is lost, and why that loss follows from the cause of failure |
| Preserved content | What does not roll back, so completed actions are not erased |
| Retry point | The current action, the current situation, the start of the segment, or the initial state of the full run |
| Defined initial state | The location, tools, event history, and random conditions after a restart |
| Recovery path | What the player can change next, rather than merely repeating the punishment |

What is preserved and what is lost should have a causal relationship. If a local mistake clears an unrelated chapter, the player will struggle to learn from the failure. If every cost is restored automatically, the rules lose their meaning.

heading.zh: 原创设计示例：旧城照片展的失败与重开
heading.en: Original Design Example: Failure and Restart in an Old-City Photo Exhibition

body.zh:
以下是原创纸面设计，不是构建、试玩或平衡结论。虚构游戏让玩家为旧城档案室准备一场照片展：桌上有三张老街照片、可公开查阅的日期簿和一位老居民的口述资料。主任务是按日期排好照片；人物关系展签是可选内容，不确定时可以如实标成“待考”。本例的口述资料只在本轮筹备中开放一次，依据的是这位居民只接受这一场访谈的故事设定，不是通用的失败次数规则。展览只印制一次：若提交的主时间线与公开日期簿冲突，开幕方会取消本轮展览。

| 结果 | 可观察触发（最后一次可改变的行动） | 终态 | 后续 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 较弱完成 | 三张照片都按日期簿排对；玩家把无法证实的人物关系标为“待考”，随后选择“送印” | 时间线正确、关系展签留白；本轮展览开放 | 目录明确保留未确认项，不把猜测写成事实；本轮不能再改已印目录 |
| 软失败 | 玩家在口述会谈中把未经资料支持的亲属关系说成定论；居民当场指出依据不足并收回口述资料 | 唯一的口述资料机会结束，但照片展筹备仍继续；日期簿和已排照片保留，尚未送印 | 玩家可继续用公开日期完成主时间线，把关系标为“待考”；口述资料本轮不可取回，主流程没有重置 |
| 硬失败 | 玩家提交的照片顺序与桌上可见的日期簿冲突，最后仍选择“送印” | 审核单标出矛盾日期；由于本轮唯一开幕安排已过，展览取消，本轮结束 | 只能选择“重新筹备”，进入下方定义的完整初态；不能在已结束的本轮偷偷改印 |

**软失败后的当前状态。** 例如，玩家已按日期簿放好两张照片，第三张仍在照片槽；日期簿保持打开，两张既有摆放保留，关系展签仍未确认。口述资料状态变为“本轮不可查阅”，访谈请求已结束；印制状态仍为未提交，展览取消标记为假，界面显示“口述资料已撤回；仍可按公开日期完成时间线”。玩家的下一项可用行动，是查看打开的日期簿并摆放第三张照片，或把关系展签留作“待考”。没有按钮能重新索要这份口述资料；继续主任务不是重试访谈。

**硬失败后的整轮重开。** 玩家回到档案室筹备桌，界面没有打开的结果卡或送印对话框。三张照片都回到各自照片槽；日期簿回到本轮作者设定的起始页并保持可查；访谈请求恢复到“尚未进行”；所有摆放、关系展签、审核结论、送印记录和开幕状态都清空。展览取消标记为假，重开后的第一个可用动作，是打开日期簿核对一张照片的日期。本例重开使用相同的照片、日期簿和作者编排顺序，不抽新题、不换随机种子。

**序列规则。** 本例的照片和日期证据固定。软失败后沿用当前已排状态与公开日期，不重置本轮；硬失败重开才清空筹备状态，并从相同的作者编排开始。它只说明两种恢复路径在纸面上各自读取什么状态，不证明提示易懂、展览规则有趣或实际实现能正确复位。
body.en:
The following is an original paper design, not a conclusion from a build, playtest, or balance test. In this fictional game, the player prepares a photo exhibition for an old-city archive. On the table are three photographs of an old street, a publicly available date ledger, and oral-history material from a longtime resident. The main task is to arrange the photographs by date. Captions about relationships between people are optional; when uncertain, the player can honestly mark them as “To Be Verified.” In this example, the oral-history material is available only once during this round of preparation because the story establishes that the resident will accept only one interview for this exhibition. This is not a general rule based on the number of failures. The exhibition has only one print run: if the submitted main timeline conflicts with the public date ledger, the opening organizers cancel the exhibition for this run.

| Result | Observable trigger (last action the player could change) | Terminal state | What follows |
|---|---|---|---|
| Weaker completion | All three photographs are correctly ordered according to the date ledger; the player marks an unverified relationship as “To Be Verified,” then selects “Send to Print” | The timeline is correct, the relationship caption remains blank, and the exhibition opens for this run | The catalog explicitly preserves the unconfirmed item rather than presenting a guess as fact; the printed catalog cannot be changed during this run |
| Soft failure | During the oral-history interview, the player states an unsupported family relationship as fact; the resident immediately points out the lack of support and withdraws the oral-history material | The only opportunity to consult the oral-history material ends, but exhibition preparation continues; the date ledger and photographs already placed remain, and nothing has been sent to print | The player can still use the public dates to complete the main timeline and mark the relationship as “To Be Verified”; the oral-history material cannot be recovered during this run, and the main process does not reset |
| Hard failure | The submitted photograph order conflicts with the date ledger visible on the table, and the player still selects “Send to Print” as the final action | The review sheet marks the conflicting dates; because the only opening slot for this run has passed, the exhibition is canceled and the run ends | The only option is “Restart Preparation,” which enters the complete initial state defined below; the player cannot quietly revise the printing in a run that has already ended |

**Current state after the soft failure.** For example, the player has placed two photographs according to the date ledger, while the third remains in its photo slot. The date ledger stays open, the two existing placements remain, and the relationship caption is still unconfirmed. The oral-history material changes to “Unavailable for the Rest of This Run,” and the interview request has ended. The print state remains unsubmitted, the exhibition-canceled flag is false. The interface displays: “Oral-history material withdrawn; you can still complete the timeline using public dates.” The player's next available action is to consult the open date ledger and place the third photograph, or to leave the relationship caption marked “To Be Verified.” No button can request the same oral-history material again; continuing the main task is not a retry of the interview.

**Full restart after the hard failure.** The player returns to the preparation table in the archive. No result card or print dialog is open in the interface. All three photographs return to their respective photo slots. The date ledger returns to the opening page authored for this run and remains available to consult. The interview request returns to “Not Yet Conducted.” All placements, relationship captions, review findings, print records, and opening states are cleared. The exhibition-canceled flag is false. The first available action after the restart is to open the date ledger and check the date of one photograph. This example reuses the same photographs, date ledger, and authored sequence after a restart; it does not draw a new puzzle or change a random seed.

**Sequence rule.** The photographs and date evidence are fixed in this example. After the soft failure, the current arrangement and public dates remain in effect; the current run does not reset. Only a restart after hard failure clears the preparation state and begins again from the same authored sequence. This only shows which state each recovery path reads in the paper design. It does not establish that the prompts are easy to understand, that the exhibition rules are fun, or that an implementation can reset correctly.

heading.zh: 失败原因要指向下一次可改变的事
heading.en: The Cause of Failure Should Point to What the Player Can Change Next

body.zh: 失败说明要把最近一次仍可改变的行动、规则反应和后果连起来。档案展例中，“口述资料不可用”只是结果；“把未获资料支持的亲属关系说成定论，居民因此收回本轮口述资料”才指出玩家做了什么、为何失去这条可选来源，以及哪些公开证据仍可使用。硬失败也不能只显示“展览失败”：应指出送印顺序与哪一条可见日期记录冲突，并说明本轮开幕安排已经取消。原因提示不应泄露玩家尚未获得的事实，也不应把随机结果伪装成玩家犯错。
body.en: A failure explanation should connect the most recent action the player could still change, the rule's response, and the consequence. In the archive-exhibition example, “oral-history material unavailable” states only the result. “The player presented an unsupported family relationship as fact, so the resident withdrew the oral-history material for this run” identifies what the player did, why that optional source was lost, and which public evidence remains available. A hard failure likewise should not display only “Exhibition Failed.” It should identify which visible date record conflicts with the order sent to print and explain that the opening arrangement for this run has been canceled. The explanation should not reveal facts the player has not obtained or present a random result as if it were the player's mistake.

heading.zh: 重开要恢复一套定义好的初态
heading.en: A Restart Must Restore a Defined Initial State

body.zh: 写“重新开始”还不够。逐项决定玩家回到哪里、界面停在什么状态、物件与证据是否恢复、已完成结果是否保留、临时输入和进行中的结算是否清空，以及随机局面沿用、重置还是更换。本例的软失败不重开：访谈机会已失去，照片和日期簿仍可继续完成主任务。硬失败才结束本轮；整轮重开把三张照片、日期簿、访谈请求、关系展签、印制记录和开幕状态全部恢复到作者写定的筹备初态。如果同一个“继续”按钮有时保留、有时清空，应在结果页面说清本次范围。
body.en: Writing “restart” is not enough. Decide where the player returns, what state the interface shows, whether objects and evidence are restored, whether completed outcomes remain, whether temporary input and in-progress resolution are cleared, and whether a random situation is retained, reset, or replaced. The soft failure in this example is not a restart: the interview opportunity is gone, while the photographs and date ledger can still be used to complete the main task. Only the hard failure ends the run. A full restart restores the three photographs, the date ledger, the interview request, relationship captions, print record, and opening state to the authored preparation state. If the same “Continue” button sometimes preserves state and sometimes clears it, the result screen should state the scope of this recovery.

heading.zh: 恢复路径要给出新的行动机会
heading.en: A Recovery Path Should Provide a New Opportunity to Act

body.zh: 失败后的恢复路径要符合已发生的损失。口述资料被撤回后，不要给一个会把同一访谈重置回未发生的按钮；让玩家用仍可查阅的日期簿完成主时间线，并把没有证据支持的关系留作“待考”。硬失败后本轮已经结束，玩家只能进入明示的整轮重开，而不是从已取消的开幕流程继续送印。信息可以变清楚，但恢复规则不应悄悄抹去玩家已经造成的后果。
body.en: The recovery path after failure should respect what has already been lost. After the oral-history material is withdrawn, do not provide a button that resets the same interview as though it never happened. Let the player complete the main timeline with the date ledger that remains available and leave an unsupported relationship marked “To Be Verified.” After a hard failure, the run has ended, so the player can only enter an explicitly labeled full restart rather than continue sending material to print from an opening process that has already been canceled. Information can become clearer, but the recovery rules should not quietly erase a consequence the player has already caused.

heading.zh: 在纸面上走完失败、恢复和再次行动
heading.en: Walk Through Failure, Recovery, and the Next Action on Paper

body.zh: 从一个完整初态走两条路径：第一条里，玩家因无依据的关系断言失去口述来源，然后确认公开日期簿、完成时间线并以“待考”展签送印；第二条里，玩家把照片排在与可见日期冲突的位置仍送印，审核指出冲突并取消本轮，再选择整轮重开。每一步都写结果页面、已保留与已丢失的状态、下一项可行动作。纸面走读只能检查描述是否自洽；真正的复位行为和玩家是否看懂原因仍需在构建后验证。
body.en: Starting from one complete initial state, walk through two paths. In the first, the player loses the oral-history source by making an unsupported claim about a relationship, then checks the public date ledger, completes the timeline, and sends it to print with the relationship caption marked “To Be Verified.” In the second, the player places a photograph in a position that conflicts with a visible date and still sends it to print; the review identifies the conflict and cancels this run, after which the player selects a full restart. At each step, write down the result screen, the state that was preserved and lost, and the next available action. A paper walkthrough can only check whether the description is internally consistent. Actual reset behavior and whether players understand the cause still require validation after a build exists.

heading.zh: 常见失败设计问题与修正
heading.en: Common Failure-Design Problems and Fixes

body.zh:
| 问题 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 所有不完美结果都判失败 | 区分有效弱结果、软失败和终止本轮的失败 |
| 失败只写“任务失败” | 指出可观察触发和最近一次可改变的关系 |
| 局部失误清空无关进度 | 明确保留内容与合适的重试位置 |
| 重开后资源、事件历史含糊 | 逐项定义初态和随机条件 |
| 软失败保留奖励，却能再次领取 | 让历史和领取状态进入恢复后的规则 |
| 能回到开头就宣称没有问题 | 构建后验证实际状态，并试玩理解与代价 |
body.en:
| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| Treating every imperfect outcome as failure | Distinguish a valid weaker outcome, a soft failure, and a failure that ends the run |
| Explaining failure only as “Mission Failed” | Identify the observable trigger and the most recent relationship the player could change |
| Clearing unrelated progress after a local mistake | Define what is preserved and choose an appropriate retry point |
| Leaving resources and event history ambiguous after a restart | Define the initial state and random conditions item by item |
| Preserving a reward after soft failure but allowing it to be claimed again | Make history and claim state part of the recovered state |
| Claiming there is no problem merely because the player can return to the beginning | Validate the actual state in a build and playtest whether players understand the cause and cost |

q.zh: 失败一定要扣资源或清空进度吗？
q.en: Must Failure Always Consume Resources or Clear Progress?

a.zh: 不用。失败后果要与失败原因和项目承诺相连，可以失去局部机会、进入较弱结果或回到合适的决策点。保留范围应明确且诚实。
a.en: No. The consequence should follow from the cause of failure and the project's promises. The player can lose a local opportunity, enter a weaker outcome, or return to an appropriate decision point. The scope of what is preserved should be explicit and honest.

q.zh: 软失败和坏结局有什么区别？
q.en: What Is the Difference Between a Soft Failure and a Bad Ending?

a.zh: 软失败通常让主进程继续，同时丢失局部所得或机会；坏结局是已经完成的一种终态。具体命名不重要，重要的是玩家知道当前是否结束、哪些状态保留以及还能做什么。
a.en: A soft failure usually lets the main progression continue while losing a local gain or opportunity. A bad ending is a completed terminal state. The name matters less than ensuring that the player knows whether the current run has ended, which state is preserved, and what they can still do.

text.zh: 在已有 SOURCE_BIBLE.md、选定 CONCEPT.md 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md 的项目中，用 `/game-world-design`（Codex 用 `$game-world-design`）为每类失败填写触发、可读原因、保留与失去内容、重试位置、定义初态和恢复路径，并走完失败后的第一次再行动。只交付设计，不构建或宣称完成试玩。
text.en: In a project with an existing SOURCE_BIBLE.md, a selected CONCEPT.md, and a PRODUCT_BRIEF.md, use `/game-world-design` (`$game-world-design` in Codex) to record the trigger, readable cause, preserved and lost content, retry point, defined initial state, and recovery path for each type of failure, then walk through the first action after recovery. Deliver design only; do not build the game or claim that playtesting is complete.

title.zh: 同一角色多套造型怎么管理：从身份卡到造型版本表
title.en: How to Manage Multiple Looks for One AI Short-Drama Character

seo_title.zh: 同一角色多套造型管理｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Manage Multiple AI Character Looks | ZenStory

description.zh: 把固定身份、多套造型、短暂变化和镜头状态分开管理。附身份卡、造型版本表、三套造型示例与穿帮修正。
description.en: Separate identity, reusable looks, brief deltas, and shot state. Includes a character card, look registry, three-look example, and mismatch fix.

answer.zh: 管理同一角色的多套造型时，先把换装后仍成立的可见特征写进身份卡，再为每组能同时成立、在剧情中持续或复现的外观建立 Look，并注明起因和生效范围。范围可以精确到场次、动作段或镜头边界；一场中途换装时，在相应边界切换。只维持一两镜的局部油污可记为短暂 delta；表情、姿势和视线属于镜头状态。道具的持有人、持有手、位置及转手由 Prop/State 保留为权威记录，分镜再把该状态投影到镜头起止边界。
answer.en: To manage multiple Looks for one character, put visible traits that survive costume changes in a Character card, then create a Look for each compatible appearance that persists or returns in the story, with its cause and valid range. A range can resolve to a scene, action block, or shot boundary; when a change happens mid-scene, switch at that boundary. A grease mark that lasts for only a shot or two can remain a brief delta; expression, pose, and gaze belong to shot state. Prop/State remains the authoritative record for a prop's holder, hand, location, and transfers; storyboards project that record to shot start/end boundaries.

heading.zh: 先用五个去处分清身份、造型与镜头状态
heading.en: Sort Every Detail Into Five Places

body.zh:
| 去处 | 判断规则 | 常见内容 |
|---|---|---|
| Character 身份 | 换衣、受伤或跨时段后仍用来认出此人 | 稳定脸部与头部比例、体态轮廓、永久特征、基础发质与发际 |
| 可复用 Look | 一组能同时成立的外观，在明确时段持续或重复使用 | 服装、鞋履、具体梳法、妆容、伪装、包扎、污渍 |
| 短暂 delta | 只改变当前 Look 的局部，维持很短且无需独立登记 | 一两镜的袖口粉笔痕、刚沾上的灰、临时解开一颗扣子 |
| shot state | 记录每镜的起止边界与可见执行 | 姿势、位置、视线、双手、持物和可见状态；引用资产状态，不另造一套 |
| Prop/State | 道具连续性的权威记录 | 道具身份、负责人/持有人、左手或右手、位置、状况、转手原因与有效范围 |

一项外观变化跨多个 block/scene 持续、后面会再次使用、需要独立参考，或会改变观众识别与剧情信息时，就建立新 Look。短促变化留在 delta 或镜头状态。道具的持有人、手位、位置及变化仍由 Prop/State 记录；分镜再把既有状态投影到每个镜头的起止边界。人物如何跨镜保持可识别，见 [AI 短剧角色一致性](/drama-skills/character-consistency)；本页只处理多套造型的时间登记与切换。
body.en:
| Place | Decision rule | Typical contents |
|---|---|---|
| Character identity | Still identifies the person after a costume change, injury, or time jump | Stable face and head proportions, body silhouette, permanent traits, base hair texture and hairline |
| Reusable Look | A compatible appearance combination that persists or returns during a defined span | Clothing, shoes, a specific hairstyle, makeup, disguise, bandaging, or dirt |
| Brief delta | A local change to the current Look that lasts briefly and needs no separate entry | A chalk mark on a cuff for one or two shots, fresh dust, or one temporarily opened button |
| Shot state | Records each shot's start/end boundaries and visible execution | Pose, position, gaze, both hands, held items, and visible state projected from asset records—not a second source of truth |
| Prop/State | The authoritative record for prop continuity | Prop identity, owner/holder, left or right hand, position, condition, transfer cause, and valid range |

Create a new Look when an appearance change persists across multiple blocks or scenes, returns later, needs its own reference, or changes recognition or story information. Keep passing changes in a delta or shot state. Prop/State remains authoritative for a prop's holder, hand, position, and changes; storyboards project that existing state to each shot's start and end boundaries. For recognition across shots, see [character consistency in AI short drama](/drama-skills/character-consistency); this guide focuses on registering and switching among multiple Looks over story time.

heading.zh: 可复制的角色身份卡与造型版本表
heading.en: Copyable Character Card and Look Registry

body.zh:
先用一张小卡片建立唯一身份依据：

> **角色名／编号：** ___  
> **稳定可见锚点：** ___  
> **侧面锚点：** ___  
> **背面锚点：** ___  
> **永久特征：** ___  
> **锚点的来源场景与可见依据：** ___  
> **不写入身份的临时内容：** 服装／伤势／天气／表情／姿势／其他 ___  
> **身份参考：** ___

再按剧情时间登记 Look。每一行代表一段连续有效区间；区间首尾场次、动作段或镜头段都包含在内。造型复现时沿用原 Look ID，但新增一行记录新的有效区间：

| Look ID | 相对身份或上一版的可见变化 | 原因／事件 | 首个有效范围 | 最后有效范围 | 场景来源与可见依据 | 视觉参考 | 不可共存状态 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LOOK-___ | ___ | ___ | SC___ / A___ | SC___ / A___ | SC___：___ | ___ | ___ |

例如旧造型在 SC006/A02 结束，新造型从 SC006/A03 开始；A02 与 A03 紧邻，避免区间重叠或漏空。“场景来源与可见依据”记录剧本事实，不要用造型板代替。

手持道具另用 Prop/State 记录权威状态：

| 道具 ID | 负责人／持有人 | 左手或右手 | 位置／状况 | 有效范围 | 场景来源与变化依据 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PROP-___ | ___ | ___ | ___ | SC___ / A___ 至 ___ | SC___：___ |

shot state 按镜头起止边界呈现这份既有状态，不替代道具登记。
body.en:
Start with one card as the single identity reference:

> **Character name / ID:** ___  
> **Stable visible anchors:** ___  
> **Side-view anchor:** ___  
> **Back-view anchor:** ___  
> **Permanent traits:** ___  
> **Source scenes and visible evidence for the anchors:** ___  
> **Temporary details excluded from identity:** clothing / injury / weather / expression / pose / other ___  
> **Identity reference:** ___

Then register Looks against story time. Each row represents one continuous valid range. Its first and last scene, action block, or shot span are inclusive. If the same appearance returns later, keep its Look ID and add a separate row for the new valid range:

| Look ID | Visible change from identity or previous Look | Cause / event | First valid span | Last valid span | Source scene and visible evidence | Visual reference | Incompatible state |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LOOK-___ | ___ | ___ | SC___ / A___ | SC___ / A___ | SC___: ___ | ___ | ___ |

For example, an old Look can end at SC006/A02 and a new one start at SC006/A03. The spans meet without overlap or a gap. “Source scene and visible evidence” records the script fact; a Look sheet is not a substitute.

Track held props separately in Prop/State:

| Prop ID | Owner / holder | Left or right hand | Position / condition | Valid range | Source scene and change evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PROP-___ | ___ | ___ | ___ | SC___ / A___ to ___ | SC___: ___ |

Shot state shows this existing record at each shot boundary; it does not replace the prop entry.

heading.zh: 沿故事时间登记 Look，并为每个连续区间选择版本
heading.en: Register Looks on the Timeline and Select One for Each Span

body.zh:
1. 从剧本标出每次换装、伪装、受伤、清洗与时间跳跃，并记录变化从哪个场次、动作段或镜头边界生效。
2. 把换装后仍成立的可见事实收回身份卡。身份锚点至少包括一项侧面成立的事实和一项背面成立的事实；制服、当天妆容和临时伤痕留在 Look 或短暂变化里。
3. 合并同一有效时段能共存的内容，为它写一条 Look；工作服与检修日反光背心若在不同场次使用，各自建版本。
4. 为每个连续区间记录首个与最后一个有效动作/镜头段、变化原因，以及对应场景和剧本证据。受伤从实际发生的剧本块或动作段开始，前面的镜头不能提前使用。
5. 为每个连续场次区间或场内镜头段指定一个当前 Look；中途换装、受伤或脱外套时，在相应边界切换。首尾范围都包含在内：旧 Look 可到 A02 为止，新 Look 从 A03 开始；单个镜头只引用一套相容 Look。
6. 制作造型参考板时，一张板只承载一套相容造型。板式与视角写法见[角色三视图提示词](/drama-skills/character-turnaround-prompt)。

造型恢复时，沿用原 Look ID 并另开一行登记新有效区间。例如 A → B → A 要分别登记 A 的第一次使用、B 的区间、A 的再次使用；每段都写明源场景和变化依据。检查相邻边界是否刚好相接。道具则检查 Prop/State 的持有人、手位与位置是否和镜头起止状态一致。
body.en:
1. Mark each costume change, disguise, injury, cleanup, and time jump in the script, including the scene, action block, or shot boundary where the change takes effect.
2. Move visible facts that persist across outfits into the Character card. Include at least one fact observable in profile and one from the back; keep uniforms, today's makeup, and temporary injuries in a Look or brief delta.
3. Group details that coexist during the same valid span and create one Look for that combination. Workwear and a clinic vest used in different spans get separate versions.
4. For every continuous range, record its first and last valid action/shot span, the cause, and the source scene with visible evidence. Start an injury Look at the script block or action where the injury occurs; earlier shots cannot use it.
5. Assign one active Look to each continuous scene or shot span. If a change happens mid-scene, switch at the relevant boundary. Both endpoints are inclusive: the old Look can end at A02 and the new one start at A03; any one shot references one compatible Look.
6. When a Look needs a reference sheet, put only one compatible appearance on that sheet. See the [character turnaround prompt guide](/drama-skills/character-turnaround-prompt) for views and layout.

When an appearance returns, reuse its Look ID but add a separate row for the new valid range. An A → B → A sequence therefore has a row for A's first use, one for B, and another for A's return; each range names its source scene and evidence. Check adjacent boundaries for gaps or overlaps. Also verify that Prop/State holders, hand placement, and locations agree with each shot's start/end state.

heading.zh: 原创示例：单车修理师林芃的三套造型
heading.en: Original Example: Three Looks for Bicycle Mechanic Lin Peng

body.zh:
虚构短剧里，单车修理师林芃先在店里整备旧车，随后到学校参加一日公益检修，之后回店继续维修，几天后又去社区电台录制访谈。三套造型跨四段有效区间，由同一张身份卡串起。边界按动作段拆开：SC005/A01 仍穿店装、进入更衣区，SC005/A02 首次出现检修造型；SC009/A01 仍穿检修造型、进入店内更衣区，SC009/A02 才是换回店装后的第一个有效段；SC011/A01 仍穿店装、进入访谈准备区，SC011/A02 首次出现访谈造型。

**身份卡**

> 角色名／编号：林芃／CHAR-LINPENG  
> 稳定可见锚点：平直眉弓、宽鼻翼、下巴中央浅凹  
> 侧面锚点：鼻梁中段从侧面看略向外凸  
> 背面锚点：后脑勺上方有两个并排发旋  
> 永久特征：左腕内侧一颗浅色小痣  
> 来源与可见依据：SC001 的侧面镜头显示鼻梁弧度；SC002 的背影显示双发旋；SC003 的拿取零件动作露出腕内侧小痣  
> 身份参考：已确认的中性身份板

**连续造型区间表**

每行是一段连续有效区间。LOOK-LP-SHOP 在公益检修后原样复现，所以 ID 相同但需另开一行；三次换装都在相邻动作段之间完成：旧造型到 A01 为止，新造型从下一段 A02 开始，边界分别是 SC005/A01→A02、SC009/A01→A02、SC011/A01→A02。

| Look ID | 相对身份的可见变化 | 原因／事件 | 首个有效范围 | 最后有效范围 | 场景来源与可见依据 | 视觉参考 | 不可共存状态 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LOOK-LP-SHOP | 藏青工作夹克、炭灰围裙、卷发别在耳后 | 单车店维修班次 | SC001 | SC005/A01 | SC001/A01：侧后镜头清楚显示工作夹克、围裙与别耳卷发 | 店内造型 A | 反光背心、访谈衬衫 |
| LOOK-LP-CLINIC | 灰色 Polo 外穿亮绿色反光背心，摘掉围裙，头发扎起，双手戴耐油工作手套 | 学校公益检修日 | SC005/A02 | SC009/A01 | SC005/A02：检修段开始时已穿 Polo 与反光背心、摘下围裙、扎起头发，并已戴耐油工作手套 | 检修日造型 B | 炭灰围裙、访谈衬衫 |
| LOOK-LP-SHOP | 与首段相同，未增加衣发变化 | 回店维修班次；在 SC009/A01 进入更衣区后换回 | SC009/A02 | SC011/A01 | SC009/A02：离开更衣区后穿回工作夹克和围裙，头发仍别在耳后 | 店内造型 A | 反光背心、访谈衬衫 |
| LOOK-LP-RADIO | 浅蓝衬衫、深灰长裤、头发用小夹子固定 | 社区电台访谈；在 SC011/A01 的准备区换装 | SC011/A02 | SC012 | SC011/A02：进入访谈间时穿浅蓝衬衫、深灰长裤并用小夹子固定头发 | 录音造型 C | 工作夹克、反光背心 |

**SC006 / A03 道具状态：**PROP-BIKE-01 的负责人是林芃，当前无人手持，固定在维修架上，链条朝向工作台；PROP-CLOTH-01 的负责人和持有人是林芃，由她右手持有，准备擦链条。场景状态记在 Prop/State，分镜再按起止边界呈现。检查链条时，少量润滑脂蹭到左手套食指侧；A03 结束前已用布擦净。这道油污只在一个镜头段出现，不需独立登记，因此记作作用于 LOOK-LP-CLINIC 的短暂 delta。SC006 的姿势、视线、持布手和接触位置写入镜头状态，并引用对应道具状态。
body.en:
In this fictional short drama, bicycle mechanic Lin Peng first tunes old bikes at the shop, joins a one-day repair clinic at a school, returns to the shop for more repairs, and records a community-radio interview a few days later. Three Looks cover four continuous valid spans, all tied to one Character card. Changes happen between adjacent action blocks: Lin Peng is still in shop clothes in SC005/A01 and enters the changing area; SC005/A02 is the first clinic-Look span. In SC009/A01, Lin Peng is still in the clinic Look and enters the shop changing area; the returned shop Look begins at SC009/A02. In SC011/A01, Lin Peng is still in shop clothes and enters the interview prep area; the radio Look begins at SC011/A02.

**Character card**

> Character name / ID: Lin Peng / CHAR-LINPENG  
> Stable visible anchors: straight brow ridge, broad nostrils, a shallow dip at the center of the chin  
> Side-view anchor: the middle of the nose bridge has a slight outward curve in profile  
> Back-view anchor: two adjacent hair whorls sit high on the back of the head  
> Permanent trait: a small pale mole on the inside of the left wrist  
> Source and visible evidence: SC001's profile shot shows the nose-bridge curve; SC002's rear view shows both whorls; the parts-pickup action in SC003 reveals the mole on the inside of the wrist  
> Identity reference: approved neutral identity sheet

**Continuous Look-range ledger**

Each row is one continuous valid span. LOOK-LP-SHOP returns after the clinic, so its ID is reused in a separate row. Each change falls between adjacent action blocks: the old Look ends at A01 and the new one starts at A02, at SC005/A01→A02, SC009/A01→A02, and SC011/A01→A02.

| Look ID | Visible change from identity | Cause / event | First valid span | Last valid span | Source scene and visible evidence | Visual reference | Incompatible state |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LOOK-LP-SHOP | Navy work jacket, charcoal apron, curls tucked behind the ears | Bike-shop repair shift | SC001 | SC005/A01 | SC001/A01: a side/rear shot clearly shows the jacket, apron, and tucked curls | Shop Look A | Reflective vest, interview shirt |
| LOOK-LP-CLINIC | Bright green reflective vest over a grey polo, apron removed, hair tied back, with oil-resistant work gloves on both hands | School repair-clinic day | SC005/A02 | SC009/A01 | SC005/A02: the clinic span opens with the polo and vest on, apron off, hair tied back, and oil-resistant work gloves already on | Clinic Look B | Charcoal apron, interview shirt |
| LOOK-LP-SHOP | Same appearance as the first span; no added clothing or hair change | Returns to a repair shift; changes back after entering the changing area in SC009/A01 | SC009/A02 | SC011/A01 | SC009/A02: after leaving the changing area, Lin Peng wears the jacket and apron again, with curls tucked behind the ears | Shop Look A | Reflective vest, interview shirt |
| LOOK-LP-RADIO | Pale-blue shirt, charcoal trousers, hair held with a small clip | Community-radio interview; changes in the prep area in SC011/A01 | SC011/A02 | SC012 | SC011/A02: entering the interview room in the pale-blue shirt and charcoal trousers, with hair held by a small clip | Recording Look C | Work jacket, reflective vest |

**SC006 / A03 prop state:** Lin Peng is responsible for PROP-BIKE-01, which is secured on the repair stand with the chain facing the workbench and is not being held. Lin Peng is responsible for PROP-CLOTH-01, which she holds in her right hand, ready to wipe the chain. Record this scene state in Prop/State, then project it to shot boundaries. While checking the chain, a little lubricant transfers to the left index-finger side of the glove; Lin Peng wipes it off before A03 ends. This mark lasts for only one shot span and needs no separate entry, so it is a brief delta on LOOK-LP-CLINIC. Put the pose, gaze, hand holding the cloth, and contact location for SC006 in shot state, referencing the relevant prop state.

heading.zh: 常见穿帮：公益检修背心混进电台访谈造型
heading.en: Common Mismatch: The Clinic Vest Carries Into the Radio Interview

body.zh:
**穿帮结果：** SC011/A02 的电台访谈画面同时出现浅蓝衬衫、亮绿色反光背心和炭灰围裙，前两段剧情的衣物被混进当前造型。

**排查：** 假设初稿把检修日 Look 的结束范围留空，也只写了“林芃去电台录制”，没有为 SC011/A02 选中访谈 Look；旧造型因此仍像是有效状态。

**修正记录：** 先将 LOOK-LP-CLINIC 的有效终点记为 SC009/A01，将 LOOK-LP-SHOP 的再次使用记为 SC009/A02–SC011/A01，再将 LOOK-LP-RADIO 的起点记为 SC011/A02；随后在该场次或镜头段绑定当前版本：

> SC011/A02 当前造型：LOOK-LP-RADIO。沿用 CHAR-LINPENG 的平直眉弓、宽鼻翼、下巴中央浅凹、侧面鼻梁微凸、后脑勺并排发旋和左腕内侧浅色小痣。当前外观为浅蓝衬衫、深灰长裤、小夹子固定头发。不得带入 LOOK-LP-SHOP 的藏青工作夹克和炭灰围裙，也不得带入 LOOK-LP-CLINIC 的亮绿色反光背心。

修正时只补齐已有变化的原因、剧本来源与有效范围，不新增衣物、配饰或脸部细节。场内换装按动作段或镜头边界拆分；有效端点首尾包含，上一段在 A01 结束、新一段从 A02 开始，避免重叠或空档。
body.en:
**Mismatch:** The SC011/A02 radio-interview image combines the pale-blue shirt with a bright green reflective vest and charcoal apron, carrying clothes from earlier story spans into the current Look.

**Diagnosis:** Suppose a rough draft left the clinic Look's end range blank and only said “Lin Peng goes to record at the radio station,” without selecting the interview Look for SC011/A02. The earlier appearance still looked valid.

**Correction:** Set the valid end for LOOK-LP-CLINIC to SC009/A01, record LOOK-LP-SHOP's return for SC009/A02–SC011/A01, and start LOOK-LP-RADIO at SC011/A02. Then bind the active version to that scene or shot span:

> Current appearance for SC011/A02: LOOK-LP-RADIO. Preserve the CHAR-LINPENG anchors: straight brow ridge, broad nostrils, shallow dip at the center of the chin, slight nose-bridge curve in profile, twin whorls high on the back of the head, and small pale mole on the inside of the left wrist. Current appearance: pale-blue shirt, charcoal trousers, hair held with a small clip. Do not carry over the navy work jacket and charcoal apron from LOOK-LP-SHOP or the bright green reflective vest from LOOK-LP-CLINIC.

Only repair the cause, script source, and valid range of the existing change; do not add clothing, accessories, or facial details. Keep the changing action in A01 and make the new Look effective from A02. Valid endpoints are inclusive: the old Look ends at A01 and the new one starts at A02, with no overlap or gap.

q.zh: 角色后来回到以前的造型，要新建 Look 吗？
q.en: Should I create a Look when a character returns to an earlier appearance?

a.zh: 如果旧造型在剧情后段原样恢复，可以沿用原来的 Look 编号，并在版本表另加一行记录新的连续有效区间；若发型、服装或妆容有重要变化，就另建 Look 并写清差异。每一行都要注明对应的场景来源和可见依据。
a.en: If the earlier appearance returns unchanged later in the story, reuse its Look ID but add a separate row for the new continuous valid range. If the hair, clothing, or makeup materially changes, create a new Look and note the difference. Every row should name its source scene and visible evidence.

q.zh: 受伤、包扎或淋雨都要单独建 Look 吗？
q.en: Does every injury, bandage, or rain effect need its own Look?

a.zh: 按是否持续、重复、影响识别和需要单独登记判断。跨多场的包扎或持续妆面变化适合登记成 Look；一两镜的擦伤颜色加深、袖口粉笔痕可留作短暂变化。无论放在哪一层，都要从实际发生的场次开始，不能提前出现在剧情里。
a.en: Judge by persistence, reuse, effect on recognition, and whether a separate entry is needed. Bandaging or a makeup change that spans scenes belongs in a Look; an abrasion briefly darkening or a chalk mark on a cuff can remain a short-lived delta. In either case, the change starts only after its story event, never in an earlier scene.

q.zh: 同一场中途换装怎么登记？
q.en: How do I record an outfit change within a scene?

a.zh: 把有效范围按首尾均包含的动作段或镜头段拆开：例如旧 Look 写到 SC006/A02 为止，新 Look 从 SC006/A03 开始；两段相接，不重叠也不漏空。若场内还有第三套造型，继续按边界另开区间。
a.en: Split the valid range into inclusive action or shot spans: for example, the old Look ends at SC006/A02 and the new Look starts at SC006/A03. The spans meet without overlap or a gap. If a third Look appears within the scene, add another range at its boundary.

q.zh: 每套造型都要重新写一遍脸部描述吗？
q.en: Should every Look repeat the full face description?

a.zh: 不用。每套 Look 引用同一身份卡，只写相对身份或上一版的可见变化。这样身份只有一份权威记录，改发型、服装或包扎时也不会顺手改掉脸型和永久特征。
a.en: No. Point every Look to the same Character card and write only visible differences from identity or the previous version. That leaves one authoritative identity record and prevents a hairstyle, costume, or bandage change from silently rewriting face shape or permanent traits.

text.zh: 身份卡和造型版本表确认后，在 Claude Code 中说：“用 /short-drama-image-prompts 分别为已登记的三套 Look 写人物造型参考板提示词，每张板只绑定一套相容造型，并沿用同一身份锚点。”Codex 中使用 `$short-drama-image-prompts`。该技能写提示词文件，不生成图片。
text.en: After the Character card and Look registry are approved, ask in Claude Code: “Use /short-drama-image-prompts to write a separate character Look-sheet prompt for each of the three registered Looks. Bind one compatible appearance per sheet and preserve the same identity anchors.” In Codex, use `$short-drama-image-prompts`. The skill writes prompt files; it does not generate images.

title.zh: 短剧只有一个点子怎么展开：把灵感变成故事引擎
title.en: How to Turn One Short-Drama Idea into a Story Engine

seo_title.zh: 短剧点子怎么展开成故事引擎｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Turn a Short-Drama Idea into a Story Engine | ZenStory

description.zh: 先区分点子与故事引擎，再用精简创作简报比较两种机制，填写引擎卡，并用三轮状态变化测试能否持续推进。
description.en: Separate a premise from a story engine, compare two mechanisms in a compact brief, build an engine card, and test three rounds for real state change.

answer.zh: 短剧只有一个点子时，先别急着凑分集。点子只说明谁处在什么处境；故事引擎还要说明压力怎样再次出现、主角如何应对、对抗力量如何反制、每轮留下什么必须被后续继承的状态，以及哪些有因果的新变化可以改写它。先把观众回报、主题张力、主角追求、昂贵阻力、独特矛盾、内容边界和终止性转变写成精简创作简报，再比较机制真正不同的方向。选定后填写引擎卡，用若干连续冲突轮次检查资源、知识、权力或关系是否发生变化；通过后才进入分集规划。
answer.en: When you have only one short-drama idea, do not pad it into episodes. A premise says who is in what situation. A story engine also explains how pressure returns, how the protagonist responds, how opposition adapts, what changed state later rounds must inherit, and what new causal development could revise it. Capture the audience reward, thematic tension, pursuit, costly resistance, central contradiction, content boundaries, and terminal change in a compact creative brief. Then compare directions that use genuinely different mechanisms. After choosing one, complete an engine card and test several consecutive conflict rounds for changes in resources, knowledge, power, or relationships. Map episodes only after that test succeeds.

heading.zh: 一句点子不是故事引擎
heading.en: A One-Line Premise Is Not a Story Engine

body.zh:
先把两种东西分开：

- **点子／前提**回答：谁遇到了什么有戏的处境？
- **故事引擎**回答：哪种压力会以不同形式回来，主角凭什么应对，对抗力量怎样学习，每一轮留下什么必须被下一轮承接的变化，以及什么新变化会让这套循环失效或改写已有状态？

本文使用一个原创生活化点子：

> 社区服务站的代班协调员周遥，希望在站长休假期间不让任何居民求助落空。

这句话提供了人物、场域和愿望，却还不能预测下一次冲突。若每次只是“又来一位更难缠的居民”，人物和规则都无因恢复原样，那是事件重复，不是引擎。能持续推进的版本必须让周遥的有效策略同时制造新代价：她每解决一次资源分配，都会改变谁有优先权、谁掌握证据、谁愿意合作，以及大家如何评价这套规则。后续轮次应继承这些状态，除非新的选择和结果有因果地改变它们。

所以，展开点子不是先列更多事件，而是找出一个会生产**选择—反制—状态变化—新压力**的回路。回路可以重复启动，但旧状态不能无故复位。这里的“几轮”是压力测试，不代表固定集数、转折数量或平台公式。
body.en:
Start by separating two things:

- A **premise** answers: who is caught in what dramatic situation?
- A **story engine** answers: what pressure can return in different forms, what method the protagonist uses, how opposition learns, what changed state the next round must carry forward, and what new development could end the loop or revise that state?

This guide uses an original, everyday premise:

> Zhou Yao, the acting coordinator at a neighborhood service center, wants to keep every resident's request from falling through while the director is away.

That line gives us a character, a setting, and a desire, but it cannot yet predict the next conflict. If every cycle merely introduces “another more difficult resident” and restores the people and rules to their starting positions without a cause, the story is repeating incidents rather than running an engine. A sustainable version makes Zhou Yao's useful method create a new cost every time. Each allocation decision changes who has priority, who controls evidence, who will cooperate, and whether the community trusts the rules. Later rounds must inherit those states unless a new choice and result causally change them.

Developing the idea therefore means finding a loop that produces **choice, countermove, changed state, and new pressure**, not listing more events. The loop may start repeatedly, but earlier state cannot reset without a cause. The rounds below are a stress test, not a prescribed episode count, turn count, or platform formula.

heading.zh: 先写一页精简创作简报
heading.en: Write a Compact Creative Brief First

body.zh:
创作简报只记录会约束后续选择的决定。未知项写“待确认”，不要用大段世界观填空，也不要替创作者猜答案。可以先填写这些字段：

| 字段 | 本例工作答案 |
|---|---|
| 原始点子 | 周遥代班管理社区服务站，希望每项求助都有着落 |
| 观众反复获得的回报 | 看见一条看似公平的处理办法解决眼前问题，又暴露新的利益与关系代价 |
| 主题张力 | 一视同仁的公平 ↔ 对具体处境的照顾 |
| 语气与边界 | 现实、温和但不回避利益冲突；不把求助者写成笑料或恶人 |
| 焦点人物与追求 | 周遥要维持服务承诺，并证明自己有能力独立协调 |
| 昂贵阻力 | 志愿时数和服务名额有限；居民掌握不同证据与公共影响力，任何例外都可能成为先例 |
| 独特矛盾 | 周遥越公开规则，越容易被人据此挑战；越私下通融，越损害规则可信度 |
| 终止性转变 | 当分配权变成居民共同承担的责任，或周遥不再以“我必须让所有人满意”行动，旧引擎就会变形 |

再补上项目实际已有的语言、观看场景、可用人物与场地规模、难以承受的制作元素，以及结局承诺或禁区。这里只确认项目方向，不写对白、场面调度、首集开场或分集节点。若一句字段不能影响人物选择或内容边界，就先删掉，而不是把简报扩成设定百科。
body.en:
A creative brief records only decisions that constrain later choices. Mark unknowns as “to be confirmed” instead of filling the page with lore or guessing on the creator's behalf. Start with these fields:

| Field | Working answer for this example |
|---|---|
| Original idea | Zhou Yao runs the neighborhood service center temporarily and wants every request to find an answer |
| Repeatable audience reward | A seemingly fair rule solves the immediate problem, then exposes a new cost in interests or relationships |
| Thematic tension | Equal treatment versus care for a particular circumstance |
| Tone and boundaries | Realistic and humane without avoiding material conflict; people seeking help are neither jokes nor villains |
| Focus and pursuit | Zhou Yao wants to preserve the center's service promise and prove she can coordinate on her own |
| Costly resistance | Volunteer hours and service slots are limited; residents hold different evidence and public influence, and any exception may become precedent |
| Distinctive contradiction | The more openly Zhou Yao states a rule, the easier it is to challenge through that rule; the more she makes private exceptions, the less credible the system becomes |
| Terminal change | The old engine transforms once allocation becomes a responsibility residents share, or once Zhou Yao stops acting from “I must satisfy everyone” |

Add only the project's real constraints: primary language, viewing context, feasible cast and locations, unaffordable production elements, and any ending promise or prohibited outcome. This stage confirms direction. It does not write dialogue, stage scenes, design an opening episode, or map episode beats. If a field cannot affect a character choice or a content boundary, remove it for now rather than turning the brief into an encyclopedia.

heading.zh: 比较两种机制，不是给同一故事换名字
heading.en: Compare Two Mechanisms, Not Two Labels

body.zh:
候选方向要改变主角策略、对抗来源、代价或冲突如何再生。下面两条都保留社区服务点子，但驱动方式不同：

| | 方向 A：公开分配规则 | 方向 B：互助信用网络 |
|---|---|---|
| 主角策略 | 周遥公布优先标准、申请依据和变更理由，用可解释的排序分配有限服务 | 周遥不再单独分配，而是把求助者与可提供技能、时间的人配对，让“受助”同时产生可选择的互助承诺 |
| 对抗机制 | 居民补充证明、重述紧急程度、联合质疑例外；每次判定都会制造可援引的先例 | 参与者隐瞒能力、拒绝欠情、转让承诺或结成小圈；网络中的债务与信任不断改写配对可能 |
| 核心代价 | 周遥承担公开裁决的声誉与关系代价，规则越清楚，争议也越能精确攻击其漏洞 | 周遥接触更多私人处境，若配对失败会同时损害双方信任，还可能让互助变成道德压力 |
| 反复回报 | 观众看见一次公平判断怎样重新分配资源、话语权和规则解释权 | 观众看见一次互助交换怎样生成新联盟、新债务或拒绝关系 |
| 终止条件 | 分配权被共同治理取代，或周遥放弃单人裁判身份 | 互助不再依赖周遥居中担保，或社区拒绝用关系债务交换服务 |

方向 B 不是把“排队表”改叫“互助表”。它让周遥从裁判变成撮合者，对抗从规则争议变成债务与信任，失败成本也从公共合法性转向私人关系和隐私。

本例选择**方向 A**，因为它最直接承载“公平与照顾难以兼得”的主题张力，也能用同一处普通服务站呈现权力、证据和联盟的变化。方向 B 留作未选方案，不应在后续悄悄混进既定引擎；若创作者想组合两者，需要重新确认代价和终止条件。
body.en:
Candidate directions must change the protagonist's method, the source of opposition, the cost, or the way conflict regenerates. Both options below preserve the neighborhood-service premise, but they run on different mechanisms:

| | Direction A: public allocation rules | Direction B: a mutual-aid credit network |
|---|---|---|
| Protagonist's method | Zhou Yao publishes priority criteria, required evidence, and reasons for changes, then allocates scarce services through an explainable order | Instead of allocating alone, Zhou Yao matches people who need help with people who can offer time or skills, allowing assistance to create an optional reciprocal commitment |
| Opposition mechanism | Residents add evidence, reframe urgency, or organize challenges to exceptions; every ruling creates a precedent others can cite | Participants hide capabilities, reject social debt, transfer commitments, or form cliques; debt and trust continually reshape which matches are possible |
| Central cost | Zhou Yao absorbs the reputational and relational cost of public judgment; the clearer the rule, the more precisely its gaps can be attacked | Zhou Yao learns more private circumstances; a failed match damages trust on both sides and may turn mutual aid into moral pressure |
| Repeatable reward | Viewers see one fairness decision redistribute resources, voice, and authority to interpret the rules | Viewers see one exchange create a new alliance, obligation, or refusal |
| Terminal condition | Shared governance replaces unilateral allocation, or Zhou Yao gives up the role of sole judge | Mutual aid no longer depends on Zhou Yao's guarantee, or the community rejects trading services through relational debt |

Direction B is not the same queue renamed as a mutual-aid list. It changes Zhou Yao from judge to matchmaker, moves opposition from rule disputes to debt and trust, and shifts the cost of failure from public legitimacy to private relationships and privacy.

This example selects **Direction A** because it carries the tension between equal treatment and particular care most directly, while allowing changes in power, evidence, and alliances to remain visible in one ordinary service center. Direction B stays unselected and should not leak into the accepted engine. Combining them would require the creator to reconsider the costs and terminal condition.

heading.zh: 把选定方向压成一张故事引擎卡
heading.en: Compress the Chosen Direction into an Engine Card

body.zh:
引擎卡不是剧情梗概。它写的是能预测下一次选择的因果回路：

> **压力来源：** 新求助与已承诺的服务争夺同一批志愿时数或名额，而现有信息总不完整。  
> **主角惯常策略：** 周遥把紧急程度、影响人数和替代路径公开列入排序，并解释每次调整。  
> **策略为何有效：** 有限资源不再靠熟人或音量分配，决定可以被检查。  
> **策略怎样制造新问题：** 居民会围绕标准补证、结盟或指出例外；一次通融会成为下一次争议的筹码。  
> **对抗与反制：** 求助者、志愿者和社区委员各自保护时间、名誉与被照顾的群体，会改变提交信息、撤回合作或要求共同审议。  
> **一轮结果：** 某项求助得到处理，但资源余额、规则解释权、证据分布或关系债务至少有一项改变，后续轮次必须承接，除非新的因果结果再次改写。  
> **下一股压力：** 刚形成的先例让另一项需求获得新资格，或让原本合作的人有理由拒绝。  
> **不能轻易退出：** 周遥已经代表服务站作出承诺；放弃会让未完成的求助和失去信任的志愿者留给同事承担，也会击穿她对“可靠”的自我认同。  
> **终止性转变：** 居民和志愿者共同承担标准与例外的决定，或周遥接受“可靠不等于让所有人满意”，不再独占裁决与责任。  
> **内容与制作边界：** 冲突来自有限服务和关系选择，不靠夸张反派、突发犯罪或豪华场景；主要动作可发生在普通服务站、公告渠道和既有社区服务流程中。

最关键的是“局部结果”和“下一股压力”之间有因果关系。新压力若可以随意换成任何陌生麻烦，说明这张卡只能生成题材相似的事件，还不能生成同一条持续变化的故事。
body.en:
An engine card is not a plot synopsis. It records a causal loop that can predict the next choice:

> **Source of pressure:** A new request competes with an existing commitment for the same volunteer hours or service slots, while the available information is always incomplete.  
> **Protagonist's usual method:** Zhou Yao openly ranks urgency, number of people affected, and available alternatives, then explains each adjustment.  
> **Why it works:** Scarce resources are no longer allocated through personal connections or whoever speaks loudest; decisions can be examined.  
> **How it creates a new problem:** Residents gather evidence around the criteria, form alliances, or identify exceptions. One accommodation becomes leverage in the next dispute.  
> **Opposition and adaptation:** People seeking help, volunteers, and neighborhood committee members protect their time, reputation, and constituencies. They change what information they submit, withdraw cooperation, or demand shared review.  
> **Result of one cycle:** One request receives an answer, but at least one state changes: remaining resources, authority to interpret the rules, distribution of evidence, or relational debt. Later rounds must carry it forward unless a new causal result changes it again.  
> **Next pressure:** The new precedent qualifies another need or gives a former collaborator a reason to refuse.  
> **Why the protagonist cannot simply leave:** Zhou Yao has made commitments on behalf of the center. Walking away would leave unfinished requests and distrust for her colleagues to absorb, while breaking her self-image as a reliable person.  
> **Terminal transformation:** Residents and volunteers begin sharing responsibility for standards and exceptions, or Zhou Yao accepts that reliability does not mean satisfying everyone and stops monopolizing judgment and blame.  
> **Content and production boundaries:** Conflict comes from scarce services and relational choices, not exaggerated villains, sudden crime, or lavish locations. The action can remain within an ordinary service center, its public notices, and existing neighborhood-service processes.

The causal link between the local result and the next pressure is the crucial part. If the new pressure could be replaced with any unrelated problem, the card can generate incidents in the same genre, but not a single evolving story.

heading.zh: 用三轮压力测试检查状态是否真的改变
heading.en: Stress-Test the Engine for Real State Change

body.zh:
下面三轮只用于检验引擎，不是三集大纲，也不是必须采用的剧情。每一轮都从上一轮留下的状态出发：

| 检验轮次 | 触发与选择 | 反制与局部结果 | 留给下一轮的状态变化 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 第一轮：资源 | 陪诊与临时托管同时争夺仅剩的志愿时数；周遥按“无替代路径优先”安排陪诊 | 托管申请者指出自己的替代人选会因此误工；陪诊完成，但志愿时数见底 | **资源改变：** 当日余量归零；**关系改变：** 未获服务者开始联合质疑“替代路径”的定义 |
| 第二轮：知识与解释权 | 联合者提交新材料，证明一次托管能保障数名夜班家长按时到岗；周遥据此修订“影响人数”的标准，并开通公开的申诉复核入口 | 先前受益者担心已完成的决定会被追溯推翻，社区委员要求每项申诉都记录依据与处理状态；入口开始接收申请 | **知识改变：** “影响人数”有了新的可验证含义；**权力改变：** 周遥失去单独解释规则的空间，委员取得复核入口；**流程改变：** 后续争议必须进入可追踪的待处理队列 |
| 第三轮：申诉与共同责任 | 新入口收到两项相关事项：托管申请者按修订后的标准申请下一批可用时数；先前受益者要求在没有新证据时，不要把已完成的陪诊决定重新认定为无依据。两项进入同一复核议程，但不是争抢同一批时数；当日志愿时数仍为零，未来托管申请继续等待 | 周遥若继续单独裁决，就会让“公开复核”变成个人解释。组织起来的求助者愿意参与审议，但要求能质疑缺乏依据的例外；先前受益者要求把既往服务记录与未来资源排序分开处理。委员据此明确规则：没有新证据不追溯改写已完成服务，后续申请依修订后的标准排队 | **资源继承：** 当日余量仍为零，未来托管申请继续等待；已完成的陪诊保持为有效既往记录。**关系改变：** 质疑者与既有受益者共同进入审议。**权力改变：** 复核规则与未来分配责任由多人承担。**人物改变：** 周遥必须用共享责任取代独自兜底 |

读完后做四项检查：

1. 后一轮是否必须继承前一轮的资源、知识、权力或关系，除非新的选择与结果有因果地改写它？
2. 对抗力量是否从结果中学习并改变策略，而不只是提高音量？
3. 主角的办法是否既解决问题又制造她在意的代价？
4. 能否指出一种人物、事实或关系变化，会让这套旧回路自然终止或变形？

若答案是否定的，回到方向或引擎卡修订；不要靠添加陌生反派、秘密身份或更多设定遮住断裂。通过测试并由创作者接受后，这份简报和引擎才能作为后续依据。下一步若要安排每集的进入状态、局部结果和交接，再使用[短剧分集大纲](/drama-skills/episode-outline-template)；若要检查单集内部怎样完成一次因果状态变化，可参考[短剧一集结构](/drama-skills/episode-structure)；若要把已定结果写成可表演场景，再进入[短剧剧本写作](/drama-skills/screenwriting)。本页到此停止，不预写分集或首集钩子。
body.en:
The three rounds below test the engine. They are not a three-episode outline or mandatory plot. Each round starts from the state left by the previous one:

| Test round | Trigger and choice | Countermove and local result | State carried forward |
|---|---|---|---|
| Round one: resources | A medical escort and temporary childcare compete for the last volunteer hours. Zhou Yao applies “no available alternative comes first” and assigns the escort | The childcare applicant shows that the supposed alternative would miss work. The escort is completed, but the volunteer pool is exhausted | **Resource change:** no hours remain that day. **Relationship change:** rejected applicants organize around a challenge to the meaning of “available alternative” |
| Round two: knowledge and interpretive authority | The group submits evidence that one childcare assignment would keep several night-shift parents at work. Zhou Yao revises the meaning of “number affected” and opens a public appeal-and-review channel | The earlier beneficiary worries that a completed decision could be reversed retroactively, while a committee member demands that every appeal record its basis and status. The channel begins accepting cases | **Knowledge change:** “number affected” gains a new verifiable meaning. **Power change:** Zhou Yao loses room to interpret the rule alone, and the committee gains a review role. **Process change:** later disputes must enter a trackable pending queue |
| Round three: appeals and shared responsibility | The new channel receives two related matters: the childcare applicant requests the next available hours under the revised criteria; the earlier escort recipient asks that the completed service not be relabeled unjustified without new evidence. They enter one review agenda but do not compete for the same hours. Today's pool remains empty, so the future childcare request stays queued | If Zhou Yao rules alone again, public review becomes another form of personal discretion. The organized applicants will join the review only if they can challenge unsupported exceptions; the earlier recipient asks reviewers to keep the completed service record separate from future allocation.
