The committee sets a rule: absent new evidence, completed service is not rewritten retroactively, while future requests follow the revised criteria | **Resource state carried forward:** no hours remain that day, so the future childcare request stays queued; the completed escort remains a valid past record. **Relationship change:** challengers and an existing beneficiary enter shared review. **Power change:** responsibility for review and future allocation is shared. **Character change:** Zhou Yao must replace solitary rescue with shared responsibility |

Now ask four questions:

1. Must each later round inherit a resource, knowledge, power, or relationship state from the previous one unless a new choice and result causally revise it?
2. Does the opposing force learn from results and change its method rather than merely becoming louder?
3. Does the protagonist's method solve a problem while creating a cost she genuinely cares about?
4. Can you name a change in character, fact, or relationship that would naturally end or transform the old loop?

If not, revise the direction or engine card. Do not hide the break by adding an unrelated villain, secret identity, or more lore. Once the test passes and the creator accepts the brief and engine, they can guide downstream work. Use the [short-drama episode outline](/drama-skills/episode-outline-template) only when you are ready to assign entry states, local results, and handoffs to episodes. Consult [short-drama episode structure](/drama-skills/episode-structure) when testing how one episode completes a causal state change. Move to [short-drama screenwriting](/drama-skills/screenwriting) only after those results are defined and you are ready for playable scenes. This guide stops here; it does not prewrite episodes or an opening hook.

q.zh: 一句话梗概和故事引擎有什么区别？
q.en: What is the difference between a logline and a story engine?

a.zh: 一句话梗概概括人物、追求和处境；故事引擎还要说明压力怎样回来、人物和对抗者怎样应对、每轮留下什么供后续继承，以及什么变化会终止旧回路。梗概可以吸引人，但引擎能帮助你判断后续冲突是否来自同一套因果。
a.en: A logline summarizes a character, pursuit, and situation. A story engine also explains how pressure returns, how the protagonist and opposition adapt, what each cycle leaves for later cycles to inherit, and what would end the old loop. A logline may be compelling, but an engine lets you judge whether later conflicts arise from the same causal system.

q.zh: 为什么要比较两个方向？必须每次都写两个吗？
q.en: Why compare two directions, and must I always write two?

a.zh: 当点子还没有机制时，对比能暴露真正的选择：主角做法、对抗来源和核心代价究竟是什么。两个方向在本文中只是足以看出差别的示范，不是固定数量。若创作者已经明确选择，就直接深化，不为凑选项制造伪差异。
a.en: When an idea has no mechanism yet, comparison exposes the real decision: the protagonist's method, the source of opposition, and the central cost. Two directions are enough to demonstrate that distinction here, but they are not a required count. If the creator has already chosen a mechanism, deepen it instead of inventing false alternatives.

q.zh: 三轮压力测试等于三集吗？
q.en: Do the three stress-test rounds equal three episodes?

a.zh: 不等于。轮次只是检验一次结果能否因果地制造下一次压力。一轮可能跨集，也可能一集包含多轮；这些都应在进入分集规划后按项目节奏决定。此处只检查状态能否被后续继承，并在新因果出现时继续变化。
a.en: No. A round only tests whether one result causally creates the next pressure. A round may span episodes, or one episode may contain several rounds; decide that later according to the project. At this stage, test only whether later work inherits the state and changes it when a new cause appears.

q.zh: 什么时候可以开始写分集大纲？
q.en: When is the idea ready for an episode outline?

a.zh: 当创作者已接受方向，简报中的人物追求、昂贵阻力、反复回报和终止性转变彼此一致，引擎又能连续产生由后续继承或有因改写的状态变化时，再进入分集。仍会改变主角、对抗机制或结局承诺的问题，应先留在简报中解决。
a.en: Begin episode mapping after the creator accepts the direction, the pursuit, costly resistance, repeatable reward, and terminal change agree with one another, and the engine produces consecutive states that later work either inherits or revises for a stated cause. Resolve any question that would still change the protagonist, opposition mechanism, or ending promise in the brief first.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 中说：“用 /short-drama-develop 把这个原创短剧点子发展到创作简报和故事引擎：先保留我的题材、语气、结局与内容边界，比较机制真正不同的方向，等我选择后写 creative-brief.md 和 story-engine.md；用连续冲突轮次检查状态变化，暂不制作分集地图、场景或对白。”Codex 中使用 `$short-drama-develop`。该技能会把只有想法的项目先做方向探索，再建立简报与引擎；方向选择仍由创作者确认。
text.en: In Claude Code, say: “Use /short-drama-develop to take this original short-drama idea only as far as a creative brief and story engine. Preserve my genre, tone, ending, and content boundaries; compare directions with genuinely different mechanisms; after I choose, write creative-brief.md and story-engine.md. Stress-test state changes across consecutive conflict rounds, but do not create an episode map, scenes, or dialogue yet.” In Codex, use `$short-drama-develop`. The skill explores directions for an idea-only project before building the brief and engine; the creator still chooses the direction.

title.zh: AI解说视频什么时候加字幕？先锁定画面和声音
title.en: When to Add Subtitles to an AI Recap Video

seo_title.zh: AI解说视频什么时候加字幕｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: When to Add Subtitles to an AI Recap | ZenStory

description.zh: 先锁定无包装母版，再按实际 TTS 和时间线生成字幕、抽检代表画面、沿现有项目路径合成，并复核最终音轨与成片。
description.en: Lock picture and sound first. Build captions from final TTS and timing, check sample frames, composite, and review the final audio and video.

answer.zh: AI解说视频的字幕动画、边框和花字应在画面、主要剪点、实际旁白和混音稳定后制作。先输出无包装母版，再依据正在使用的 TTS 与时间线生成字幕提示，抽检代表画面，沿项目已有路径渲染字幕层并叠加。合成后确认音轨没有被意外改写，再完整播放实际最终文件。叙事不清、剪点不对或声音难听时，先修对应上游层，不要用包装遮盖。
answer.en: Create subtitle animation, borders, and decorative text only after the picture, main cuts, actual narration, and mix are stable. First export a clean master, then generate caption cues from the TTS and timeline actually in use, inspect representative frames, and render and overlay the subtitle layer through the project's existing path. After compositing, confirm that the audio was not changed accidentally and watch the actual final file from beginning to end. If the narrative is unclear, a cut is wrong, or the sound is poor, fix that upstream layer instead of covering it with packaging.

heading.zh: 字幕包装依赖已经稳定的音画
heading.en: Subtitle Packaging Depends on Stable Picture and Sound

body.zh:
字幕不是独立于成片的最后一张贴纸。它读取正在使用的旁白文字和时间，出现在具体镜头与剪点上，还要和最终混音一起进入交付文件。只要这些上游内容仍在变化，包装就可能跟着返工：

- 换镜或移动剪点，会让已经调好的字幕出入点和动画落在错误画面；
- 重录旁白，会改变文字、时长和停顿，旧提示不再对应实际 TTS；
- 调整混音，可能需要重新确认字幕出现时观众究竟听到什么；
- 更换画面，会让原先不遮挡的边框、花字或字幕覆盖新的剧情信息。

这里的“锁定母版”是指画面顺序、主要剪点、实际旁白和混音已作为本次包装输入确定，并输出一份不含本轮字幕动画、花字和边框的干净版本。锁定不代表以后永远不能改；若上游内容确实改变，就承认包装输入已经失效，从干净母版和新时间线重新生成，而不是在旧动画上不断补丁。
body.en:
Subtitles are not a final sticker independent of the video. They read the narration text and timing actually in use, appear over specific shots and cuts, and enter the delivery file alongside the final mix. As long as those upstream elements keep changing, the packaging may need to be rebuilt:

- Replacing a shot or moving a cut can leave carefully timed subtitle entrances, exits, and animation on the wrong picture.
- Re-recording narration changes words, duration, and pauses, so old cues no longer match the actual TTS.
- Revising the mix may require another check of what the audience hears while each subtitle is visible.
- Replacing the picture can cause a border, decorative caption, or subtitle that was previously clear to cover new story information.

A “locked master” here means that the shot order, main cuts, actual narration, and mix have been accepted as the inputs for this packaging pass, and that a clean version without this pass's subtitle animation, decorative text, or borders has been exported. Locking does not mean the video can never change. If upstream content does change, acknowledge that the packaging input is obsolete and regenerate from the clean master and new timeline instead of layering patches onto the old animation.

heading.zh: 先判断问题属于哪一层
heading.en: Identify Which Layer Owns the Problem First

body.zh:
包装可以提高可读性和一致性，但不能替代叙事、剪辑或声音修正。先隐藏字幕、花字和边框，查看无包装母版；若问题仍在，就回到对应上游层。

| 问题层 | 可观察现象 | 应回到哪里处理 | 不要用什么掩盖 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 叙事 | 看完仍不知道人物为何行动，或一句解说缺少前因后果 | 解说稿与信息分配 | 用更多强调词和字幕动画假装重点明确 |
| 剪辑 | 解说已经提到物件，画面却还没出现；或关键反应被切掉 | 画面选择与剪点 | 用箭头、边框或重复文字弥补错位 |
| 声音 | 旁白听不清、音量突然跳变，或原声与旁白互相抢 | 实际旁白录音与混音 | 用大字替代可听懂的声音 |
| 包装 | 音画内容本身成立，但字幕错时、漏字、遮挡信息，或动画在切点残留 | 字幕提示、字幕层与合成输出 | 继续堆另一层效果 |

这个分类是返工路由，不是质量证明。上游问题修好后，仍要重新输出干净母版，再进入包装顺序。
body.en:
Packaging can improve readability and consistency, but it cannot replace narrative, editing, or sound fixes. First hide the subtitles, decorative text, and borders and review the clean master. If the problem remains, return to the corresponding upstream layer.

| Problem layer | Observable symptom | Where to fix it | Do not conceal it with |
|---|---|---|---|
| Narrative | The viewer still cannot tell why a character acts, or a narration line lacks cause and effect | The recap script and information allocation | More emphasized words and caption animation that merely imitate clarity |
| Edit | The narration names an object before it appears, or a key reaction has been cut away | Shot selection and cut points | Arrows, borders, or repeated text used to compensate for the mismatch |
| Sound | Narration is hard to hear, level changes are abrupt, or source audio competes with the voice-over | The actual narration recording and mix | Large text used as a substitute for intelligible sound |
| Packaging | The picture and sound already work, but a caption is mistimed, missing text, covering information, or leaving animation across a cut | Caption cues, the subtitle layer, and the composite output | Another effect stacked on top |

This classification routes rework; it does not prove quality. After fixing an upstream problem, export a new clean master before re-entering the packaging sequence.

heading.zh: 按五步完成字幕与视觉包装
heading.en: Complete Subtitle and Visual Packaging in Five Steps

body.zh:
按下面顺序执行，并把每一步的输入写清：

1. **锁定无包装母版。** 确认画面顺序、主要剪点、正在使用的旁白和混音不再为本轮包装变化，输出不含本轮字幕动画、花字和边框的母版。
2. **从实际 TTS 与时间线生成 captions。** 使用最终采用的旁白文字、真实时长和落点建立字幕提示。字幕提示可以按阅读需要拆分，但这一步不是为了包装重写 TTS；旁白内容若变，先更新录音与时间线。
3. **抽检代表画面。** 至少查看开头、亮背景、暗背景、人物近景和长字幕出现的实际画面，确认本项目准备采用的文字与包装方案能够阅读且没有挡住重要内容。本篇不规定固定字号、颜色或安全区。
4. **沿现有项目路径渲染并叠加。** 先生成完整字幕层或项目既有的字幕输出，再把它叠到锁定母版。已有项目使用 ASS 就沿用该路径；已有其他经过确认的透明层或合成流程，也继续用它，不为这张清单强行更换依赖。
5. **复核最终文件。** 合成后确认最终音轨没有被意外替换、截短或重复，然后从头到尾播放实际交付文件，检查字幕出入、切点边界、遮挡和残留。

只有上一步输入稳定，下一步的精调才值得保留。若第二步发现 TTS 仍会修改，就回到旁白；若第五步发现音轨不同，就回到合成输出，而不是只改字幕外观。
body.en:
Follow this order and record the input used at each step:

1. **Lock a clean master.** Confirm that the shot order, main cuts, narration in use, and mix will not change during this packaging pass, then export a master without this pass's subtitle animation, decorative text, or borders.
2. **Generate captions from the actual TTS and timeline.** Build caption cues from the narration text, real duration, and placement that will be used. Caption cues can be divided for reading, but this step does not mean rewriting the TTS to suit the package. If the narration changes, update the recording and timeline first.
3. **Inspect representative frames.** At minimum, review actual frames from the opening, a bright background, a dark background, a character close-up, and a long caption. Confirm that the project's intended text and packaging treatment remain readable and do not cover important content. This article does not prescribe a fixed type size, color, or safe zone.
4. **Render and overlay through the existing project path.** Generate the complete subtitle layer or the project's established subtitle output, then composite it over the locked master. If the project already uses an ASS path, keep using it. If it has another confirmed transparent-layer or compositing workflow, keep that instead; do not replace dependencies merely to follow this checklist.
5. **Verify the final file.** After compositing, confirm that the final audio track was not accidentally replaced, truncated, or duplicated. Then play the actual delivery file from beginning to end and check subtitle entrances and exits, cut boundaries, obstruction, and residual frames.

Detailed work remains valuable only while its input stays stable. If step two reveals that the TTS will still change, return to narration. If step five reveals different audio, return to the composite output rather than changing only the appearance of the subtitles.

heading.zh: 把包装接到现有项目路径上
heading.en: Connect Packaging to the Existing Project Path

body.zh:
包装顺序不要求所有项目采用同一种工具。重点是让字幕输入、字幕输出、锁定母版和最终文件之间有明确关系。

| 项目现状 | 本次做法 |
|---|---|
| 已有 ASS 字幕交付路径 | 继续使用实际 TTS 与时间线生成并检查 ASS，再沿原路径合成 |
| 已有经过确认的透明字幕层或品牌包装流程 | 用同一流程输出完整图层，再叠加到锁定母版 |
| 尚无项目级包装路径 | 先停在方案与样帧检查阶段，由项目选择实现；不要把某个框架写成所有人的前置条件 |

不论路径是哪一种，都要保留一份无包装母版，并把合成后的结果当作新的待验证文件。单独看字幕层正常，不等于它与实际画面、切点和声音合在一起也正常。
body.en:
The packaging order does not require every project to use the same tool. What matters is a clear relationship between caption input, subtitle output, the locked master, and the final file.

| Current project state | What to do for this pass |
|---|---|
| An ASS subtitle delivery path already exists | Generate and check the ASS against the actual TTS and timeline, then composite through the existing path |
| A confirmed transparent subtitle-layer or branded packaging workflow already exists | Use that same workflow to output the complete layer, then overlay it on the locked master |
| No project-level packaging path exists yet | Stop at the plan and sample-frame review while the project chooses an implementation; do not make one framework a prerequisite for everyone |

Whatever the path, preserve a clean master and treat the composite as a new file that still requires validation. A subtitle layer that looks correct by itself may not remain correct when combined with the actual picture, cuts, and sound.

heading.zh: 原创纸面示例：观测站解说的两种顺序
heading.en: Original Paper Example: Two Packaging Orders for an Observatory Recap

body.zh:
以下是原创纸面方案，没有生成视频、渲染字幕、试听音轨或完成播放检查。虚构的 AI 解说短片讲一名调查员进入废弃观测站：镜头 A 显示墙上日历，镜头 B 显示天文钟表盘，镜头 C 显示值班日志。初版旁白说“他在表盘上找到警报密码”，设计者立刻给“警报密码”做弹跳花字，并在表盘外加发光边框。

随后叙事核对发现，真正的因果是日历日期帮助调查员找到对应的值班日志，表盘不是密码来源。画面顺序改为先看日历，再翻日志；旁白也改录为“他用日历上的停电日期，找到了同一天的值班记录”。这时，提前制作的花字引用了已经删除的说法，动画时长不再对应新 TTS，发光边框也挂在被替换的镜头上。包装没有解决叙事错误，只把错误做得更醒目。

| 过早包装 | 按锁定顺序包装 |
|---|---|
| 在旁白与镜头仍会改时制作逐字动画和边框 | 先确认日历、日志与新旁白组成的无包装母版 |
| 用旧文案手填字幕时间 | 从实际采用的新 TTS 与时间线生成提示 |
| 只看表盘镜头调整效果 | 抽检开头、日历、日志近景和最长字幕所在画面 |
| 在旧导出上继续修补动画 | 沿项目已有字幕路径生成完整层并叠加到锁定母版 |
| 只预览动画片段 | 计划核对最终音轨并完整播放实际交付文件 |

右栏仍只是计划中的正确执行顺序，不代表这段虚构短片已经渲染或验证。它说明返工来自上游输入改变，而不是字幕效果做得不够多。
body.en:
The following is an original paper design. No video was generated, no subtitles were rendered, no audio was auditioned, and no full-playback check was completed. This fictional AI recap follows an investigator entering an abandoned observatory. Shot A shows a wall calendar, shot B shows an astronomical clock face, and shot C shows a duty log. The first narration draft says, “He finds the alarm code on the clock face.” The designer immediately creates a bouncing decorative caption for “alarm code” and adds a glowing border around the clock.

A later narrative check finds that the real causal link is the calendar date helping the investigator locate the corresponding duty log; the clock face is not the source of a code. The shot order changes to show the calendar before the log, and the narration is re-recorded as, “He uses the blackout date on the calendar to find the duty record from the same day.” The early decorative caption now repeats a deleted claim, its animation duration no longer matches the new TTS, and its glowing border is attached to a replaced shot. Packaging did not solve the narrative error; it only made the error more prominent.

| Packaging too early | Packaging after lock |
|---|---|
| Build word-by-word animation and a border while narration and shots can still change | First confirm a clean master containing the calendar, log, and new narration |
| Enter subtitle timing by hand from the old copy | Generate cues from the new TTS and timeline actually in use |
| Adjust the effect after viewing only the clock shot | Inspect the opening, calendar, log close-up, and frame containing the longest caption |
| Keep patching animation onto an old export | Generate the complete layer through the project's existing subtitle path and overlay it on the locked master |
| Preview only the animated fragment | Plan to verify the final audio and play the actual delivery file from beginning to end |

The right column is still only the correct planned order. It does not mean that this fictional short was rendered or validated. It shows that the rework comes from changing upstream inputs, not from having too few subtitle effects.

heading.zh: 给每一步留下可追溯的输入
heading.en: Leave a Traceable Input for Every Step

body.zh:
团队交接时，至少写下四项：本轮无包装母版是哪一版、字幕依据哪一版实际 TTS 与时间线、字幕层或 ASS 输出放在哪里、哪个合成文件等待最终检查。这样，旁白改动后可以明确哪些下游文件失效，也能避免把旧字幕层叠到新母版。

若最终检查发现问题，按归因表退回最近的有效输入：叙事、剪点或声音变化就重出无包装母版；只有字幕提示或视觉效果有问题时，才保留母版并重做包装层。不要把“已导出”写成“已验证”；只有实际最终文件的音轨得到确认并完成播放检查，才能记录对应检查结果。
body.en:
For a team handoff, record at least four items: which clean-master version belongs to this pass, which actual TTS and timeline version the captions use, where the subtitle layer or ASS output is stored, and which composite file awaits final review. Then a narration change clearly invalidates the affected downstream files, and the team is less likely to overlay an old subtitle layer on a new master.

If the final check finds a problem, return to the latest valid input identified by the diagnosis table. A narrative, cut, or sound change requires a new clean master. Only when the problem belongs to caption cues or visual treatment should the master remain while the packaging layer is rebuilt. Do not record “exported” as “verified.” A check result can be recorded only after the audio in the actual final file has been confirmed and the playback review has been completed.

heading.zh: 常见包装顺序错误与修正
heading.en: Common Packaging-Order Mistakes and Fixes

body.zh:
| 错误 | 修正 |
|---|---|
| 剪点和旁白未定就精调字幕动画 | 先锁定无包装母版，再投入逐条包装 |
| 按旧稿生成字幕，而不是按实际 TTS | 从正在使用的录音与时间线重建 captions |
| 用花字强调来掩盖叙事不清 | 回到解说稿与信息顺序，修好后重出母版 |
| 为了包装清单临时更换整套工具 | 沿用项目已经确认的 ASS 或透明层路径 |
| 只检查单独字幕层 | 在合成后的实际最终文件里检查音画关系 |
| 默认叠加字幕不会影响声音 | 合成后明确确认音轨未被替换、截短或重复，并完整播放 |
body.en:
| Mistake | Fix |
|---|---|
| Fine-tuning subtitle animation before cuts and narration are settled | Lock a clean master before investing in cue-by-cue packaging |
| Generating subtitles from an old script instead of the actual TTS | Rebuild captions from the recording and timeline in use |
| Using emphasized decorative text to conceal an unclear narrative | Return to the recap script and information order, then export a new master after fixing them |
| Replacing the entire toolchain merely to follow a packaging checklist | Keep using the project's confirmed ASS or transparent-layer path |
| Checking only the subtitle layer by itself | Check picture-and-sound relationships in the actual final composite |
| Assuming subtitle overlay cannot affect sound | After compositing, explicitly confirm that audio was not replaced, truncated, or duplicated, then complete full playback |

q.zh: 画面还没锁定时，可以先准备字幕吗？
q.en: Can I Prepare Subtitles Before the Picture Is Locked?

a.zh: 可以整理文字草稿和标记待核对内容，但不要把旧稿的时码、逐字动画和边框当成最终资产。画面、剪点、实际旁白和混音稳定后，再从正在使用的 TTS 与时间线生成正式提示；这不要求为了字幕重新改写 TTS。
a.en: You can prepare a text draft and mark items that still need confirmation, but do not treat timing, word-by-word animation, or borders built from an old draft as final assets. Once the picture, cuts, actual narration, and mix are stable, generate the formal cues from the TTS and timeline in use. This does not require rewriting the TTS for the subtitles.

q.zh: 字幕层单独看没问题，为什么还要完整播放最终文件？
q.en: Why Play the Full Final File If the Subtitle Layer Looks Correct by Itself?

a.zh: 字幕层单独预览看不到它与真实镜头、切点和最终音轨的全部关系。叠加后仍可能出现错时、遮挡、边界残留，音轨也可能在合成中被意外替换或截短。先确认最终音轨，再从头到尾播放实际交付文件。
a.en: A subtitle-layer preview cannot show its full relationship with the real shots, cut points, and final audio. After compositing, cues can still be mistimed, cover important content, or leave residual frames at boundaries, and the audio can be accidentally replaced or truncated. Confirm the final audio, then play the actual delivery file from beginning to end.

text.zh: 在已安装 Video Recap Skills 的宿主中调用 `/video-recap`，提供无包装母版、实际 TTS／时间线、现有字幕路径和交付要求，先要求按“锁母版—生成 captions—抽检代表画面—沿现有路径叠加—复核音轨并完整播放”的顺序给出计划。若只需顺序与归因建议，明确停在纸面方案；不要声称已经渲染或验证成片。
text.en: In a host with Video Recap Skills installed, call `/video-recap` with the clean master, actual TTS and timeline, existing subtitle path, and delivery requirements. First request a plan in this order: lock the master, generate captions, inspect representative frames, overlay through the existing path, then verify the audio and complete full playback. If you only need sequencing and diagnosis guidance, explicitly stop at the paper plan and do not claim that the final video was rendered or validated.

title.zh: 小说支线怎么写才不拖主线：目标、作用与回归点
title.en: How to Write a Subplot That Serves the Main Plot

seo_title.zh: 小说支线怎么写才不拖主线｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Write Subplots That Serve the Main Plot | ZenStory

description.zh: 用支线作用卡连接主线冲突、支线目标、状态改变与汇聚点，再通过删除和合并测试判断一条支线该保留、暂停还是删改。
description.en: Use a function card to connect a subplot’s goal and obstacles to a main-plot change, convergence point, and remove-or-merge test.

answer.zh: 支线不拖主线的关键，不是缩短篇幅或限制数量，而是让它改变主线接下来的条件。先写清当前主线冲突与目标，再给支线一个当下目标和阻碍；支线结束一个阶段时，必须改变主角的选择、可用资源、关键关系、已知信息或继续行动的代价。随后标出它在哪个场景或阶段汇聚回主线，或者为什么暂时放下、将来由什么事件重新启用。最后做删除测试：拿掉这条线后，主线若仍以同样的选择、代价和结果前进，就应删掉、缩短或并入别的情节。
answer.en: A subplot stays connected not because it is short or because the novel limits the number of side threads, but because it changes the conditions of the main plot. State the current main conflict and goal, then give the subplot an immediate goal and obstacle. When that thread completes a stage, it should change the protagonist's choice, available resources, key relationship, known information, or cost of continuing. Mark the scene or stage where it converges with the main plot, or explain why it pauses and what later event will reactivate it. Finally, remove it as a test: if the main plot still reaches the same choice, cost, and result, delete the thread, shorten it, or merge its function into another event.

heading.zh: 先判断支线是不是一部可拆走的第二个故事
heading.en: First Ask Whether the Subplot Is a Detachable Second Story

body.zh:
支线可以有自己的角色、愿望和局部起伏，但它不能只在主线旁边独立完成。最直接的检查是：

> 如果整条支线拿掉，主角仍获得同样的信息和资源，仍与同样的人合作或决裂，仍做出同样的关键选择，并以同样的代价到达同一结果，那么这条线目前没有改变主线。

“有关联”也不等于偶尔提到主角或共享同一座城市。真正的连接发生在状态上：支线人物拿到的证据迫使主角换计划；支线冲突消耗了主线需要的时间或人手；一段合作改变了谁愿意在高潮中站队；一次失败让原本便宜的方案变得昂贵。

这不是要求每条支线都承担所有作用，也没有固定的支线数量、章节占比或汇聚公式。你只需要指出它在当前阶段具体改变哪一项主线条件，以及这个改变何时被主线读取。
body.en:
A subplot can have its own characters, desires, and local turns, but it cannot merely finish beside the main plot. The most direct check is:

> If you remove the entire subplot and the protagonist still gains the same information and resources, forms or breaks the same relationships, makes the same decisive choice, and reaches the same result at the same cost, the thread currently does not change the main plot.

A connection is not established merely because the subplot mentions the protagonist or takes place in the same city. The real connection is a change of state: evidence found by a subplot character forces the protagonist to change plans; a side conflict consumes time or help the main plot needs; a collaboration changes who will take sides at the climax; a failure makes a previously cheap option costly.

This does not require every subplot to perform every function, and there is no fixed subplot count, chapter ratio, or convergence formula. You only need to identify the specific main-plot condition the thread changes in the current stage and when the main plot will read that change.

heading.zh: 填写一张主线—支线作用卡
heading.en: Fill Out a Main-Plot–Subplot Function Card

body.zh:
在扩写支线前，先填这张卡。每一栏写可判断的状态，不写“丰富世界观”“增加层次”这类无法核对的愿望。

> **当前主线冲突与目标：** 主角现在要完成什么？谁或什么阻止他？如果拖延，会失去什么？  
> **支线的当下目标：** 哪个角色正在争取一件什么具体结果？  
> **支线的直接阻碍：** 谁不愿意让结果发生，或缺少哪项条件？  
> **支线行动：** 角色为了目标实际做什么，而不是只谈过去或提供设定？  
> **对主线的改变：** 这段行动改变主线的哪一项——选择、资源、关系、信息或代价？改变前后分别是什么？  
> **汇聚点：** 在哪个可见事件中，主线人物必须依据这项改变采取不同做法？  
> **暂时放下点（如有）：** 当前阶段已经完成什么，哪件事仍未解决？由什么明确事件重新开启，它届时要改变主线什么？  
> **删除测试：** 整条拿掉后，主线哪项选择、条件或结果会不同？如果答不出，为什么还要保留？  
> **合并测试：** 这条线是否只重复另一条线的功能？能否把必要结果交给现有角色或场景，而不另开一段故事？

卡片不是硬性公式。写作中发现更好的因果，可以改卡；但改完要同步检查后面的主线是否仍在读取旧结果。
body.en:
Complete this card before expanding a subplot. Write observable states in each field, not wishes such as “enrich the world” or “add depth” that cannot be checked.

> **Current main conflict and goal:** What must the protagonist accomplish now? Who or what prevents it? What will be lost through delay?  
> **Immediate subplot goal:** Which character is trying to secure what specific result?  
> **Direct subplot obstacle:** Who does not want that result, or which required condition is missing?  
> **Subplot action:** What does the character actually do to pursue the goal, beyond discussing the past or supplying background?  
> **Change to the main plot:** Which condition changes—choice, resources, relationship, information, or cost? What is its state before and after?  
> **Convergence point:** In which visible event must a main-plot character act differently because of that change?  
> **Temporary pause point, if any:** What has been completed in this stage, what remains unresolved, and which explicit event will reopen it? What will it change in the main plot then?  
> **Remove test:** If the whole thread disappears, which main-plot choice, condition, or result changes? If you cannot answer, why keep it?  
> **Merge test:** Does the thread merely repeat another thread's function? Could its necessary result be assigned to an existing character or scene without opening a separate story?

The card is not a rigid formula. If drafting reveals a stronger causal link, revise the card, but then check that later main-plot scenes are not still reading the old result.

heading.zh: 让汇聚点真正改变主线条件
heading.en: Make the Convergence Point Change a Main-Plot Condition

body.zh:
支线“回到主线”不是让两组人物在同一场戏里碰面，而是让主线从此不能照旧进行。常见改变包括：

| 改变项 | 汇聚前 | 汇聚后应能看见什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 选择 | 主角只有原计划，或误以为只有一个方案 | 新证据、新承诺或新风险迫使他改选、加条件或放弃一条路 |
| 资源 | 人手、时间、资格、工具或立足点维持原状 | 支线获得、消耗、锁住或转移了主线要用的资源 |
| 关系 | 某人中立、信任或拒绝合作 | 支线中的行动让他明确站队、设限、背叛或承担承诺 |
| 信息 | 主角依据不完整或错误认识行动 | 支线带回的事实改写对手、因果、时限或方案可行性 |
| 代价 | 原方案看起来便宜、安全或不伤人 | 支线揭示或制造了必须支付的新损失 |

一条支线改变其中一项就可能成立，不必把五项全部填满。关键是后续场景要承认改变：资源已用掉就不能无故回来；关系已经破裂就不能只因切回主线而恢复；新信息若从不影响选择，也只是背景资料。
body.en:
A subplot does not “return to the main plot” merely because two groups of characters meet in one scene. It converges when the main plot can no longer proceed unchanged. Common changes include:

| What changes | Before convergence | What should become visible afterward |
|---|---|---|
| Choice | The protagonist has only the original plan, or believes there is only one option | New evidence, a promise, or a risk forces a different choice, a new condition, or the abandonment of one path |
| Resources | Help, time, authority, tools, or a place to operate remain unchanged | The subplot obtains, spends, locks, or transfers something the main plot needs |
| Relationship | Someone remains neutral, trusting, or unwilling to help | An action in the subplot makes that person take a side, impose a condition, betray someone, or accept an obligation |
| Information | The protagonist acts on incomplete or false understanding | A fact brought back by the subplot changes the opponent, causal explanation, deadline, or feasibility of a plan |
| Cost | The original plan appears cheap, safe, or harmless | The subplot reveals or creates a new loss that must be paid |

A subplot may work by changing only one of these; it does not need to fill all five. What matters is that later scenes acknowledge the change. A spent resource cannot return without a cause, a broken relationship cannot heal merely because the narration cuts back to the main plot, and new information that never affects a choice is only background.

heading.zh: 支线可以汇聚，也可以带着明确用途暂时放下
heading.en: A Subplot Can Converge or Pause with a Defined Later Function

body.zh:
支线不必在第一次接触主线时彻底结案。它有两种清楚的阶段状态：

- **汇聚并完成：** 支线目标的主要结果已经进入主线，剩余内容不会再改变后续关键条件，可以在此收束。
- **汇聚后暂时放下：** 支线已经向主线交付一次改变，但自身仍有未解决事项；正文明确记录它将由什么事件重启，以及重启后要承担什么新作用。

“以后再写”不是暂停计划。有效暂停至少写四件事：谁的目标尚未完成、目前停在什么状态、哪个可识别事件会让它回来、回来时将改变主线什么。例如，“调查结束后再处理名誉问题”仍太空；“洪水危机解除后，市议会听证会将重新审查维修日志，这份证词决定谁拥有重建水闸的权限”才说明触发与作用。

有时主线因等待、封锁或信息不足暂时无法推进，支线可以承接正文。但这段支线仍要带回主线可用的新状态，而不是趁停顿另开一个与核心冲突无关的完整故事。
body.en:
A subplot does not have to settle every issue the first time it touches the main plot. It can reach either of two clear stage states:

- **Converged and completed:** The main result of the subplot goal has entered the main plot, and the remainder will not change an important later condition, so the thread can close here.
- **Converged, then temporarily paused:** The subplot has delivered one change to the main plot but still contains an unresolved matter. The story records which event will reactivate it and what new function it will serve when it returns.

“We will return to it later” is not a pause plan. A useful pause names at least four things: whose goal remains unfinished, the exact current state, the recognizable event that will bring it back, and what it will change in the main plot upon return. For example, “deal with the reputation issue after the investigation” remains vague. “After the flood crisis, a council hearing will reopen the maintenance log, and this testimony will decide who has authority over the floodgate reconstruction” states both trigger and function.

Sometimes the main conflict cannot advance while characters wait, face a blockade, or lack information, and a subplot can carry the story during that interval. It should still return with a new state the main plot can use, rather than opening a complete unrelated story during the pause.

heading.zh: 原创纸面示例：钟楼学徒线怎样改变水闸主线
heading.en: Original Paper Example: How a Bell-Tower Apprentice Changes the Floodgate Plot

body.zh:
以下是原创纸面示例，没有引用现有小说情节，也没有写成完整章节或经过读者测试。虚构长篇《风暴钟》当前的主线是：风暴潮逼近，港务工程师江晚必须让议会同意关闭东水闸；仓储行会反对，因为关闸会让一批货船无法按原计划进港。

一条看似独立的支线跟着钟楼学徒何牧。他想取回旧维修日志，为被指控“去年漏响警报”的师父洗清责任。直接阻碍是日志被锁在行会接管的旧档案室，何牧既没有通行资格，也没人相信一个学徒能读懂继电记录。若这条线只让他找回日志、证明师父无辜，然后离开，它就是一段可拆走的名誉故事。

真正的连接来自港口信号系统：钟楼警报和东水闸远程控制共用一段信号回路，负责把关闸指令送到闸门并回传执行状态。何牧在日志中发现，行会扩建仓库时拆掉了回路的一段，却仍让江晚的父亲在检查单上签字。于是支线一次改变四项主线条件：

- **信息：** 议会即使批准远程关闸，指令也到不了东水闸；原计划不可行。
- **选择：** 江晚必须改为组织人手现场关闸，而不是只争取一纸命令。
- **关系：** 一名参与扩建的行会工头愿意带路，但条件是公开区分施工决定与普通工人的责任。
- **代价：** 公布日志能迫使行会开放通道，也会暴露江晚父亲签过有问题的检查单。

汇聚点设在议会表决前：何牧把日志交给江晚，并按日志公开测试线路——他从钟楼端发送模拟关闸指令，本地发送灯亮起，闸门端的接收灯却没有响应，证明仓库段的线路已断，远程指令无法抵达。江晚因此不再请求一项无法执行的远程命令，而是公开日志、承担家族名誉受损的代价，换取现场关闸许可和工头协助。支线不是给主线送来一件万能工具；它让原方案失效，并制造一个更昂贵的新选择。

何牧“替师父彻底洗清责任”的目标可以暂时放下，因为风暴时先处理水闸。但暂停卡要写清：日志已经进入公共记录，师父责任尚未裁定；风暴后的议会听证会会重新开启这条线；何牧对旧维护标记的解释将决定谁获得重建信号系统的权限。若后续听证不会再改变权限、联盟或江晚的责任选择，就应在本次汇聚时解决名誉问题，或删掉这段尾线。
body.en:
The following is an original paper example. It does not borrow a plot from an existing novel, has not been written as complete chapters, and has not been reader-tested. In the fictional long novel *The Storm Bell*, the current main plot is this: a storm surge is approaching, and harbor engineer Jiang Wan must persuade the council to close the eastern floodgate. The warehouse guild objects because closing it would prevent a group of cargo boats from entering the harbor as planned.

A seemingly separate subplot follows He Mu, an apprentice in the bell tower. He wants to recover an old maintenance log and clear his teacher of blame for “failing to sound last year's alarm.” The direct obstacle is that the guild has locked the log in an archive it now controls. He Mu lacks access, and no one believes an apprentice can interpret relay records. If the thread only lets him recover the log, prove his teacher innocent, and leave, it is a detachable reputation story.

The real connection comes from the harbor signaling system. The bell tower’s alarm and the eastern floodgate’s remote controls shared a circuit that carried closure commands to the gate and returned execution status. In the log, He Mu discovers that the guild removed part of the circuit during a warehouse expansion but still had Jiang Wan's father sign the inspection sheet. The subplot now changes four main-plot conditions:

- **Information:** Even if the council approves remote closure, the command cannot reach the eastern gate; the original plan cannot work.
- **Choice:** Jiang Wan must organize a team to close the gate on site instead of seeking only a written order.
- **Relationship:** A guild foreman who worked on the expansion will guide the team, but only if the public account distinguishes management decisions from the responsibility of ordinary workers.
- **Cost:** Publishing the log can force the guild to open the access way, but it will also expose Jiang Wan's father's signature on a flawed inspection.

The convergence point comes before the council vote. He Mu gives Jiang Wan the log and follows its public test procedure: he sends a simulated closure command from the bell tower. The local send light turns on, but the gate-side receive light does not, showing that the warehouse section is broken and the remote command cannot arrive. Jiang Wan no longer asks for a remote order that cannot be carried out. Instead, she publishes the log and accepts the damage to her family name in exchange for access to the gate and the foreman's help. The subplot does not hand the main plot a universal tool; it invalidates the original plan and creates a more costly choice.

He Mu's goal of fully clearing his teacher can pause because the floodgate takes priority during the storm. The pause card must still be precise: the log has entered the public record, but the teacher's responsibility remains unsettled; a council hearing after the storm will reactivate the thread; He Mu's interpretation of the old maintenance marks will decide who receives authority to rebuild the signaling system. If that later hearing will not change authority, alliances, or Jiang Wan's choice of responsibility, resolve the reputation question at this convergence point or remove the trailing thread.

heading.zh: 用删除测试和合并测试处理弱支线
heading.en: Use Remove and Merge Tests on a Weak Subplot

body.zh:
写完卡片后，做两次纸面改写。

**删除测试：** 写一版没有这条支线的主线摘要，只保留主线原有角色与事件。然后对比：关键选择有没有变化？资源、关系、信息或代价是否相同？高潮是否仍用同样的方法解决？如果答案几乎都相同，支线目前只是并排发生。

**合并测试：** 保留支线真正必要的结果，但尝试让现有角色或场景完成它。在《风暴钟》例中，如果何牧没有自己的取日志选择、师徒名誉代价和后续听证作用，只负责把“回路已断”告诉江晚，那么这条信息可以并入江晚检查水闸的场景，不必展开完整学徒线。

根据测试结果选择处理方式：

| 结果 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 删除后主线不变，且没有独立的后续作用 | 删除支线 |
| 只有一个信息或资源结果有用 | 并入现有角色、场景或另一条支线 |
| 支线改变主线条件，但展开过长 | 保留因果节点，压缩重复过程 |
| 已改变主线，又有明确的再开启触发与作用 | 汇聚后暂时放下，并记录未决状态 |
| 改变主线且自身主要目标已完成 | 在汇聚点收束 |

删除不是承认“这段写坏了”，而是把篇幅还给真正会改变故事的行动。合并也不是把所有角色写成工具人；它是在两个情节承担同一功能时，减少重复入口。
body.en:
After completing the card, make two paper revisions.

**Remove test:** Write a summary of the main plot without the subplot, using only the characters and events that already belong to the main line. Compare the versions. Does the decisive choice change? Are resources, relationships, information, and cost the same? Does the climax still use the same solution? If nearly everything remains identical, the subplot currently runs beside the main story.

**Merge test:** Preserve the subplot's genuinely necessary result, but try assigning it to an existing character or scene. In *The Storm Bell*, if He Mu has no choice of his own in recovering the log, no cost tied to his teacher's reputation, and no later function in the hearing, and merely tells Jiang Wan that the circuit is broken, that fact can enter Jiang Wan's floodgate inspection scene without supporting a full apprentice thread.

Choose a response based on the test:

| Result | Response |
|---|---|
| The main plot does not change after removal, and the thread has no independent later function | Delete the subplot |
| Only one piece of information or one resource matters | Merge it into an existing character, scene, or subplot |
| The subplot changes a main-plot condition but takes too long | Preserve the causal nodes and compress repeated process |
| It has changed the main plot and has a clear reactivation trigger and later function | Pause it after convergence and record the unresolved state |
| It changes the main plot and its own main goal is complete | Close it at the convergence point |

Deleting a thread is not an admission that the writing failed; it returns space to actions that change the story. Merging does not mean reducing every character to a tool. It removes duplicate entry points when two threads perform the same function.

heading.zh: 从支线想法走到可用节点
heading.en: Turn a Subplot Idea into Usable Story Beats

body.zh:
可以按这个顺序工作：

1. 用一句话写当前主线冲突、目标和拖延代价。
2. 写支线角色当下想得到的结果与直接阻碍。
3. 选择支线要改变的一项主线条件，并写出改变前后。
4. 安排一个可见的汇聚事件，让主线人物必须依据新状态行动。
5. 若暂时放下，记录未决状态、再开启事件和届时的主线作用。
6. 各写一版删除后的主线摘要与合并后的版本。
7. 只有当独立展开比删除或合并更能产生必要选择与代价时，才继续扩写场景。

常见问题不是“支线太长”，而是长度没有换来状态变化：配角忙了很多章，只带回主角本来就会知道的消息；支线冲突结束后，关系和资源自动复原；所谓回归只是所有人来到同一地点；暂停后没有再开启条件。先修这些因果，再决定写多少。本文只帮助一条支线接回当前主线，不替代全书大纲、感情线设计或连载节奏安排。
body.en:
Use this sequence:

1. State the current main conflict, goal, and cost of delay in one sentence.
2. State the immediate result the subplot character wants and the direct obstacle.
3. Choose one main-plot condition the subplot will change and write its before and after states.
4. Create a visible convergence event in which a main-plot character must act on the new state.
5. If the subplot pauses, record the unresolved state, reactivation event, and later main-plot function.
6. Write both a main-plot summary with the subplot removed and a version with its useful result merged elsewhere.
7. Expand the subplot into scenes only if keeping it independent creates a necessary choice and cost that removal or merging cannot provide.

The common problem is not simply that a subplot is long, but that its length produces no state change. A supporting character works for many chapters only to return with information the protagonist would have learned anyway; relationships and resources reset after the side conflict; “returning to the main plot” means only that everyone enters the same location; or a paused thread has no reactivation condition. Repair those causal links before deciding how much to write. This guide connects one subplot to the current main line; it does not replace a whole-novel outline, romance-arc design, or serialization pacing plan.

q.zh: 支线一定要在全书高潮汇聚吗？
q.en: Must Every Subplot Converge at the Novel's Final Climax?

a.zh: 不一定。支线可以在阶段高潮、一次关键选择或卷内节点汇聚，只要它交付的改变会被后续主线继承。若主要作用已经完成，就在该处收束；若暂时放下，要写明未决状态、再开启事件和后续作用。
a.en: No. A subplot can converge at a stage climax, a decisive choice, or a major point within one part of the novel, as long as the main plot inherits the change it delivers. Close the thread there if its main function is complete. If it pauses, define the unresolved state, reactivation event, and later function.

q.zh: 长篇小说应该有几条支线？
q.en: How Many Subplots Should a Long Novel Have?

a.zh: 没有通用固定数量。能同时清楚推进多少条，取决于每条线是否有不同作用、读者能否辨认当前状态、作者能否兑现汇聚或再开启。与其先定数量，不如逐条做作用卡和删除测试；功能重复的合并，没有回归点的先不展开。
a.en: There is no universal fixed number. The workable number depends on whether each thread has a distinct function, whether its current state remains clear, and whether the writer can deliver its convergence or reactivation. Instead of choosing a quota first, complete a function card and remove test for each thread. Merge duplicate functions and do not expand a thread that lacks a return point.

q.zh: 只负责放松气氛的支线要删吗？
q.en: Should a Subplot That Only Provides Relief Be Deleted?

a.zh: 短暂的缓冲场景可以存在，但不要把“放松”当成无限扩写的理由。若它不改变后续条件，就把它当作短场景控制篇幅；若要发展成持续支线，就让人物在这段经历中形成主线会读取的关系、承诺、信息或代价。
a.en: A brief release scene can exist, but “relief” is not a reason for unlimited expansion. If it changes no later condition, treat it as a short scene and control its scope. If it is meant to become a continuing subplot, let the experience create a relationship, promise, information, or cost that the main plot will later use.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 中说：“用 /story-long-write 只检查这条长篇支线怎样回到主线：填写当前主线冲突、支线目标与阻碍、它改变的选择／资源／关系／信息／代价、汇聚或暂停点，并做删除和合并测试；先给纸面方案，不写正文。”Codex 中使用 `$story-long-write`。
text.en: In Claude Code, say: “Use /story-long-write only to check how this long-novel subplot returns to the main plot. Fill in the current main conflict, subplot goal and obstacle, the choice, resource, relationship, information, or cost it changes, its convergence or pause point, and the remove and merge tests. Give me a paper plan first; do not draft prose.” In Codex, use `$story-long-write`.

title.zh: AI文字冒险游戏怎么设计：让自由输入不乱改结果
title.en: How to Design an AI Text Adventure Without Invented Outcomes

seo_title.zh: AI文字冒险游戏怎么设计｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: How to Design an AI Text Adventure | ZenStory

description.zh: 用一张回合卡把当前事实、玩家行动、成立条件、实际变化和安全叙述连起来，避免AI把无效行动写成成功结果。
description.en: Use a compact turn card to connect current facts, player action, conditions, actual change, and narration without inventing success.

answer.zh: 设计接受自由输入的AI文字冒险时，把生成叙述放在结果确认之后。先读取与本次行动有关的当前位置、持有物、通行条件和已发生事件，再判断玩家表达的动作及其成立条件；条件满足后改变游戏事实，最后让AI描述已经确认的结果。条件未满足时保持事实不变，并给出可理解的原因和下一步；遇到否定、条件句或含糊指代时先澄清，按完整语义保留玩家意图。
answer.en: When an AI text adventure accepts free-form input, place generated narration after outcome confirmation. First read the current location, possessions, access conditions, and prior events relevant to that action. Then identify the requested action and check what must be true for it to work. Change a game fact after those conditions are met, and let the AI describe the confirmed result afterward. If a condition fails, keep the facts unchanged and explain the reason and next opportunity. Clarify negation, conditions, and ambiguous references, preserving the player’s intent from the complete expression.

heading.zh: 把理解行动、确认结果和叙述结果分开
heading.en: Separate Interpreting, Confirming, and Narrating an Action

body.zh:
自由输入让玩家直接写“把桌子推到窗边，踩上去够通风口”。AI适合把这句话理解成候选行动，也可以在结果确定后写成自然的场景反馈；行动能否成立仍取决于桌子是否在房间里、桌子能否承重，以及通风口是否够得到。

一次行动要依次回答三件事：

1. **玩家想做什么？** 保留原句中的否定、先后和条件，按完整语义识别意图。
2. **当前事实允许什么？** 只检查这次行动真正依赖的位置、物件、权限、人物态度或已发生事件。
3. **实际发生了什么？** 先确认事实是否改变，再写对白、动作和环境反应。

关键结果因此拥有独立判断点：文字可以变化，同一轮已经确认的因果保持不变。
body.en:
Free-form input lets a player directly write, “Push the table under the window and stand on it to reach the vent.” AI can interpret that sentence as a candidate action and turn a confirmed result into natural scene feedback. Whether the action works still depends on the table being present, supporting the player's weight, and placing the vent within reach.

Resolve an action by answering three questions in order:

1. **What is the player trying to do?** Preserve negation, sequence, and conditions, and read the intent as a whole.
2. **What do the current facts allow?** Check only the location, objects, access, character response, or prior event that this action actually depends on.
3. **What really happens?** Confirm whether any fact changes before writing dialogue, movement, and environmental response.

This gives important outcomes an independent decision point: the wording may vary while the causality already confirmed for the turn remains fixed.

heading.zh: 先填写一张可复用的回合卡
heading.en: Start with a Reusable Turn Card

body.zh:
遇到可能改变位置、持有物、通行权或任务结果的自由输入时，先填下面这张小卡。它用于核对当前场景的关键因果，每轮只记录与本次结果直接相关的事实。

| 卡片项 | 本轮填写 |
|---|---|
| 当前相关事实 | 玩家现在在哪里？手上有什么？与这次行动直接相关的门、人物或事件处于什么状态？ |
| 玩家行动 | 玩家明确要做什么？哪些动作被否定，哪些有先后或条件？ |
| 成立条件 | 这件事成功前，必须已经具备什么事实？ |
| 实际世界变化 | 条件满足后只改变什么；不满足时明确写“无变化” |
| 安全叙述 | 只描述已确认的动作、原因和反馈；成功、奖励或损失以实际变化栏为准 |

可复制的空白句是：

> 当前相关事实：____。玩家行动：____。成立条件：____。实际变化／无变化：____。可以安全叙述：____。

卡片让最后一句只读取前面已经确认的结果。如果“安全叙述”里第一次出现了钥匙、许可、受伤或任务完成，就回到前面确认它是否已经成立。
body.en:
When free-form input could change location, possessions, access, or a quest outcome, complete this compact card first. It checks the key causality in the current scene and records only the facts directly relevant to this turn's result.

| Card item | Fill in for this turn |
|---|---|
| Relevant current facts | Where is the player? What do they carry? What is the state of the door, character, or event directly involved? |
| Player action | What do they clearly want to do? Which actions are negated, sequenced, or conditional? |
| Condition | What must already be true before the action can succeed? |
| Actual world change | State the relevant change supported after the condition passes, or write “no change” when it fails |
| Safe narration | Describe only the confirmed action, reason, and feedback; base every success, reward, or loss on the actual-change field |

Use this copyable blank:

> Relevant current facts: ____. Player action: ____. Condition: ____. Actual change or no change: ____. Safe narration: ____.

The card makes the final line depend on a result that has already been confirmed. If the safe narration is the first place a key, permission, injury, or completed objective appears, return to the earlier lines and confirm that the fact has been established.

heading.zh: 先结算事实，再让文字表现它
heading.en: Resolve the Facts Before Writing the Prose

body.zh:
一轮可以按这条简单因果线检查：

> 当前事实 + 玩家行动 + 适用条件 → 实际变化或拒绝 + 可读反馈 + 下一次机会

把“我翻过围墙进入花园”先记录为玩家提出的行动。若墙太高、梯子不在场或花园尚未开放，玩家的位置保持原样。合适的反馈应说明行动停在哪里，并暴露一个可继续处理的事实，例如看见墙边有维修架，但现在没有上架权限。

条件满足时，把提交范围限制在本轮能够证明的变化。打开储物柜只改变柜门状态，玩家要通过拿取动作才能获得柜内物件；说服守门人放行只改变通行权，信任和秘密各自需要成立条件。这样，玩家随后询问“我现在在哪”“我拿到了什么”时，答案仍与刚才的叙述一致。
body.en:
Check each turn with one simple causal line:

> Current facts + player action + applicable condition → actual change or refusal + readable feedback + next opportunity

First record “I climb over the wall into the garden” as the action the player requested. If the wall is too high, the ladder is absent, or the garden is inaccessible, the player's location stays unchanged. Useful feedback says where the attempt stops and reveals a fact the player can act on next, such as a maintenance platform beside the wall that currently requires authorization.

When the condition passes, limit the committed outcome to the change established by this turn. Opening a storage cabinet changes the door state; obtaining its contents requires a taking action. Convincing a gatekeeper to allow entry changes access; trust and secrets each require their own established conditions. Later questions such as “Where am I now?” and “What am I carrying?” then stay consistent with the narration the player just read.

heading.zh: 原创纸面示例：泵站里的维修档案
heading.en: Original Design Sketch: The Pump-Station Service Record

body.zh:
虚构纸面场景设在一座停运的河岸泵站，玩家正在调查昨夜的停机原因。维修档案锁在控制室的铁柜里。值班技师米娜站在旁边，她持有开柜钥匙，并有权凭有效检修单打开这只柜子。玩家背包里有门房值班员交给自己的盖章检修单，单据标明可检查这只铁柜且仍在有效期内；玩家还没有把它交给米娜核验，因此当前没有开柜许可。

**无效行动：**“我打开铁柜，拿出昨晚的维修档案。”

| 卡片项 | 本轮内容 |
|---|---|
| 当前相关事实 | 铁柜锁着；玩家没有钥匙；米娜在场，持钥匙且有权核验有效检修单后开柜；玩家背包里有一张仍在有效期内、明确适用于这只柜子的盖章检修单，但尚未出示 |
| 玩家行动 | 打开铁柜并取走档案 |
| 成立条件 | 铁柜已开；或米娜核验适用且有效的检修单后同意，并用她的钥匙开柜 |
| 实际世界变化 | 条件不满足；铁柜仍锁着，档案仍在柜内，玩家持有物不变 |
| 安全叙述 | “柜门只响了一声，没有松动。米娜抬手制止你：‘别撬。我得先核验这只柜子的检修单，确认后才能用钥匙开柜。’” |

这段反馈指出阻力和下一步，铁柜、档案和米娜的许可都保持当前状态。

**后续有效行动：**“我把盖章的检修单给米娜看，请她核对后打开柜子。”卡片已经写明这张检修单适用于这只柜子且仍在有效期内，米娜也有权开柜并持有钥匙。她核对柜号和日期后同意开柜。本轮只把一个相关事实从“铁柜锁着”改为“铁柜已经打开”。安全叙述写米娜检查日期、转动钥匙，以及柜门打开后档案夹出现在视野里。读取档案和查明停机真相留给下一轮，玩家可以选择拿出哪一份记录进行检查。

两轮沿用同一场景：第一轮保持相关事实，第二轮只提交开柜结果，后续调查仍由玩家继续推动。
body.en:
This fictional paper scenario takes place in a decommissioned riverside pumping station, where the player is investigating the previous night's shutdown. The service record is inside a locked metal cabinet in the control room. Mina, the on-duty technician, is present, carries the key, and is authorized to open this cabinet when presented with a valid work order. The player’s bag contains a stamped order that expressly covers this cabinet and is still in date, but the player has not shown it to Mina for verification and does not yet have permission to open the cabinet.

**Invalid action:** “I open the cabinet and take out last night's service record.”

| Card item | This turn |
|---|---|
| Relevant current facts | The cabinet is locked; the player has no key; Mina is present, has the key, and is authorized to open it after verifying a valid work order; the player's bag holds a stamped order that is still in date and expressly covers this cabinet, but it has not yet been shown |
| Player action | Open the cabinet and take the record |
| Condition | The cabinet is already open, or Mina verifies a valid order for this cabinet, agrees to open it, and uses her key |
| Actual world change | The condition fails; the cabinet remains locked, the record remains inside, and the player's possessions do not change |
| Safe narration | “The cabinet rattles but does not move. Mina raises a hand. ‘Don’t force it. I need to verify the work order for this cabinet before I can use my key to open it.’” |

The response reveals the obstacle and a next step while the cabinet, record, and Mina's permission remain in their current states.

**Later valid action:** “I show Mina the stamped work order and ask her to verify it before opening the cabinet.” The card establishes that the player has a valid order for this cabinet and that Mina is the authorized keyholder. After she checks the cabinet number and date, she agrees to open it. This turn changes only one relevant fact: “cabinet locked” becomes “cabinet open.” Safe narration describes Mina checking the date, turning the key, and exposing the folders inside. Reading a record and solving the shutdown remain for a later turn, when the player can choose which document to inspect.

The two turns use the same setting: the first preserves the relevant facts, the second commits only the cabinet-opening result, and the player continues the investigation afterward.

heading.zh: 否定、条件和含糊行动不要靠猜
heading.en: Do Not Guess Through Negation, Conditions, or Ambiguity

body.zh:
自由输入最容易在四类表达里被改反。处理时保留完整语义；未解的条件、否定、指代和冲突要求进入澄清或拒绝，受影响的结果保持不变。

| 表达类型 | 玩家原话示例 | 安全处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 否定 | “别撬柜子，我只检查锁孔。” | 保留“不要撬”的限制，只执行检查；结果只包含锁孔观察，柜体和警报状态保持不变 |
| 条件 | “如果米娜确认印章有效，就请她开柜；否则把检修单收回来。” | 先确认米娜的判断，再执行对应分支；条件确认前，柜门状态保持不变 |
| 含糊指代 | “把它交给她，然后打开。” | 先问“你要把检修单交给米娜，并请她打开铁柜吗？”；对象确认前，物件和柜门状态保持不变 |
| 互相冲突 | “不要惊动米娜，但让她现在替我开柜。” | 指出两个要求目前不能同时成立，请玩家选择优先目标或换一种做法 |

澄清问题保持简短，并复述仍然有效的意图。复合请求中，只要动作含义、否定、条件、先后依赖或指代仍有一项未解且会影响结果，就先澄清或拒绝；整项请求确认前，与该请求相关的状态全部保持不变。
body.en:
Free-form input is most likely to be reversed in four kinds of expression. Preserve the complete meaning. Send unresolved conditions, negation, references, and conflicting requirements to clarification or refusal, and leave every affected outcome unchanged.

| Expression | Player's wording | Safe handling |
|---|---|---|
| Negation | “Don't force the cabinet; I only inspect the keyhole.” | Preserve “do not force” and perform only the inspection; the result contains the keyhole observation while cabinet and alarm states remain unchanged |
| Condition | “If Mina confirms the stamp is valid, ask her to open it; otherwise put the order back in my bag.” | Establish Mina's decision first, then follow the matching branch; the cabinet state remains unchanged until the condition is resolved |
| Ambiguous reference | “Give it to her, then open it.” | Ask, “Do you want to give the work order to Mina and ask her to open the cabinet?” Item and cabinet states remain unchanged until the objects are identified |
| Conflicting requests | “Don't alert Mina, but have her open the cabinet for me now.” | Explain that both requests cannot currently be satisfied together and ask which goal takes priority or whether the player wants another approach |

Keep the clarification question short and restate the intent that remains valid. In a compound request, if unresolved action meaning, negation, a condition, sequence or dependency, or a reference can affect the outcome, clarify or refuse before committing any state change tied to the request. Keep all request-related state unchanged until the entire request is resolved.

heading.zh: 只记录会影响当下决定的事实
heading.en: Track Only Facts That Affect the Current Decision

body.zh:
把记录范围集中在会改变玩家行动资格或结果的事实：当前位置、关键持有物、门和通道是否开放、已经兑现的承诺、任务是否结束，以及确实影响当前行动的人物许可或拒绝。杯子、闲谈和人物心理可按场景需要进入叙述。

判断一个事实值不值得保留，可以问：下次玩家再行动时，它会不会改变可做的事、成功条件或反馈？会影响后续的事实升级为持续状态，其余信息留在场景文字里。普通事实直接按世界状态记录；当秘密、证词、欺骗或误认确实改变行动时，再区分谁知道或相信什么。

本页解决的是**自由输入与实际结果对齐**。作品的调查、经营或互动叙事形式可先通过玩法选择确定；完整改编流程见[小说改游戏快速开始](/novel-to-game/quick-start)；分支前的信息与选择后的持续后果见[有意义的选择](/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices)。针对具体模型的提示词和游玩步骤属于后续实现阶段。
body.en:
Focus persistent records on facts that change whether an action is available or what result it can produce: current location, important possessions, open or closed passages, promises already fulfilled, whether an objective has ended, and a character's permission or refusal when it genuinely affects the current action. Cups, casual remarks, and character thoughts can enter the narration as the scene requires.

To decide whether a fact should persist, ask whether it will change the available action, success condition, or feedback the next time the player acts. Promote facts with a later effect to persistent state and keep the rest as scene detail. Record ordinary facts directly as world state. Distinguish who knows or believes something when a secret, testimony, deception, or mistaken identity changes an action.

This page addresses **alignment between free-form input and actual outcomes**. Choose the investigation, management, or interactive-narrative form through gameplay selection first. For the complete adaptation sequence, see the [novel-to-game quick start](/novel-to-game/quick-start). For information before a branch and persistent consequences after different choices, see [meaningful choices](/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices). Prompts and play instructions for a particular model belong to the later implementation stage.

heading.zh: 用一条代表路径做纸面核对
heading.en: Check One Representative Path on Paper

body.zh:
选一条会遇到阻力、再找到合法做法的普通路径，逐轮填写回合卡。每轮结束后只核对五件事：

- 叙述有没有新增卡片里不存在的成功、物件、位置或权限；
- 行动失败时，相关事实是否真的保持不变；
- 行动成功时，是否只改变已经满足条件的事实；
- 玩家能否从反馈中理解原因，并看见一个可行的下一步；
- 下一轮读取的事实是否与上一轮确认的结果一致。

泵站示例的代表路径是“直接拿档案失败 → 发现需要有效检修单 → 出示已有检修单 → 米娜开柜 → 玩家再选择要检查的记录”。如果失败后柜子却已经打开，或开柜后玩家突然知道停机原因，因果链就断了。

纸面核对用于发现设计中的因果矛盾。实际版本完成后，再用真实输入检查含糊说法、反馈可读性、多轮一致性和玩家理解，并根据观察结果修正设计。
body.en:
Choose one ordinary path in which the player meets resistance and then finds a valid approach. Complete the turn card for each turn, and check only five things afterward:

- Did the narration add a success, object, location, or permission that was absent from the card?
- When the action failed, did the relevant facts actually remain unchanged?
- When the action succeeded, did it change only facts whose conditions were met?
- Can the player understand the reason from the feedback and see one viable next step?
- Do the facts read by the next turn agree with the result confirmed in the previous one?

The representative path in the pump-station example is: “Trying to take the record directly fails → the player learns that a valid work order is required → the player presents the work order already in their bag → Mina opens the cabinet → the player chooses which record to inspect.” If the cabinet is somehow open after the failed turn, or the player suddenly knows the cause of the shutdown immediately after it opens, the causal chain is broken.

Use the paper check to find causal contradictions in the design. After a real version exists, test real input for ambiguous phrasing, readable feedback, consistency across multiple turns, and player understanding, then revise the design from those observations.

q.zh: AI文字冒险里，AI可以直接决定行动成功吗？
q.en: Should the AI decide whether an action succeeds in a text adventure?

a.zh: 行动是否成功由当前事实和成立条件确认。AI可以理解自由输入、提出行动解释，并把已确认的结果写成自然叙述；位置、持有物、权限和任务结果则按规则提交。这样，钥匙、许可和胜利都能追溯到本轮已经成立的事实。
a.en: Current facts and applicable conditions determine whether an action succeeds. AI can interpret free-form input, propose a reading of the action, and express a confirmed result naturally, while rules commit changes to location, possessions, access, and objectives. This keeps every key, permission, and victory traceable to facts established for the turn.

q.zh: 游戏世界里的哪些事实需要持续记录？
q.en: Which facts should persist in the game world?

a.zh: 持续记录会改变后续行动、成功条件或反馈的事实。桌面颜色之类的普通描写可以留在文本里；当前位置、关键物件、通道状态和已经兑现的承诺通常值得保留。当秘密、证词或欺骗改变玩法时，再额外区分谁知道或相信什么。
a.en: Persist facts that change later actions, success conditions, or feedback. Ordinary description such as the color of a desk can remain in the prose. Current location, important objects, passage state, and fulfilled promises are more likely to matter. Track who knows or believes something when secrets, testimony, or deception affect play.

q.zh: 玩家一句话里有多个动作，应该一次全部执行吗？
q.en: Should every action in a multi-part player message happen at once?

a.zh: 先保留动作顺序和条件，并逐项确认当前事实与玩家意图。前一步失败会让后一步失去前提时，就停在失败处；含糊部分会改变位置、物件或权限时，先用一句具体问题澄清。每个中间结果都要有已经成立的条件支持。
a.en: Preserve the sequence and conditions, then confirm current facts and player intent for each part. If an earlier step fails and removes the prerequisite for a later one, stop at that failure. If an ambiguous part would change location, possessions, or access, ask one concrete clarification question first. Every intermediate result needs an established condition.

text.zh: 在 `SOURCE_BIBLE.md`、已选择的 `CONCEPT.md` 和 `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md` 齐备后，运行 `/game-world-design`（Codex 用 `$game-world-design`）完成 `design/GAME_DESIGN.md`。这份完整设计产物涵盖体验与循环、世界规则与进程、决策与关卡节拍、反馈与失败、适用的叙事附件、交接边界、可执行切片和验证切片。本文的回合卡是该工作流里的一项创作者检查：把一个自由输入场景的相关事实、行动、条件、实际变化和叙述对齐，再用代表路径核对相邻回合的一致性。
text.en: Once `SOURCE_BIBLE.md`, the selected `CONCEPT.md`, and `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md` are ready, run `/game-world-design` (`$game-world-design` in Codex) to produce `design/GAME_DESIGN.md`. This full design artifact covers the experience and loop, world rules and progression, decisions and level beats, feedback and failure, any applicable narrative attachment, handoff boundaries, the executable slice, and the validation slice. The turn card in this article is one creator-facing check inside that workflow: align the relevant facts, action, conditions, actual change, and narration for one free-form-input scene, then use a representative path to check consistency between adjacent turns.

title.zh: 番茄和起点哪个好：给 AI 的两套写作简报
title.en: Fanqie vs Qidian Writing Styles: Two AI Briefs

seo_title.zh: 番茄和起点写法区别｜ZenStory
seo_title.en: Fanqie vs Qidian Writing Styles | ZenStory

description.zh: 用同一个原创梗概分别制作节奏优先与代入优先的 AI 写作简报，再按开头重点、期待线和信息顺序选择方向。
description.en: Turn one original premise into pace-first and immersion-first AI briefs, then compare opening focus, anticipation, and information order.

answer.zh: 本文按项目里的创作取舍，把番茄向和起点向整理成两套 AI 简报：节奏优先与代入优先，具体作品可按故事目标调整。希望开头迅速交付强情绪与鲜明噱头，并持续深挖一个核心情绪时，用番茄向简报；希望先建立人物处境，允许情节慢热，同时用多条铺垫和伏笔维持期待时，用起点向简报。新手先固定同一个梗概，让 AI 分别按两套简报写方向样稿，再检查哪一版更接近自己想让读者持续追问的问题。
answer.en: This page organizes the craft trade-offs in the project's source material into two AI briefs: a pace-first Fanqie-oriented brief and an immersion-first Qidian-oriented brief. Each story can adjust the emphasis to serve its own goal. Use the Fanqie-oriented brief when the opening should deliver a strong emotion and a clear hook quickly, then keep deepening one emotional question. Use the Qidian-oriented brief when the opening should establish the character’s situation first, allow a slower build, and sustain anticipation through multiple threads of setup and foreshadowing. A new writer can lock one premise, ask the AI for a direction sample from each brief, and compare which version leaves readers with the question the writer wants to sustain.

heading.zh: 先决定 AI 要优先交付哪种阅读体验
heading.en: First Decide Which Reading Experience the AI Should Prioritize

body.zh:
把已经确定的梗概填进下面四个问题。左栏更符合你的目标时，先试番茄向；右栏更符合时，先试起点向。

| 决策项 | 番茄向简报 | 起点向简报 |
|---|---|---|
| 开头最先交付什么 | 强情绪与鲜明噱头 | 人物处境与可进入的日常秩序 |
| 信息怎样出现 | 先让异常逼迫人物行动，再补行动所需背景 | 先让人物、规则和关系站稳，再让异常逐步改变理解 |
| 期待感怎样延续 | 围绕一个核心情绪反复加深压力 | 让多条铺垫与伏笔逐渐汇合 |
| 节奏怎样检查 | 快，并且每段都推动行动、压力或反馈 | 可以慢，每段仍要服务人物、线索或下一步判断 |

选择时写下一句完成标准：

> 读完这个开头，我希望读者最想追问：____。

若答案是“她会不会立刻打开那节车厢”，番茄向更贴近目标；若答案是“这座车站、失踪者和封存车厢之间到底有什么关系”，起点向更贴近目标。这一步只选择当前故事的写作重心。题材尚未确定时先用[小说类型选择](/oh-story/choosing-a-genre)；需要完整规划开篇时再进入[小说开篇设计](/oh-story/novel-opening)。
body.en:
Apply the four questions below to a premise you have already chosen. Start with the Fanqie-oriented brief when the left column matches your goal more closely, or the Qidian-oriented brief when the right column does.

| Decision | Fanqie-oriented brief | Qidian-oriented brief |
|---|---|---|
| What the opening delivers first | A strong emotion and a clear hook | The character's situation and a familiar routine readers can step into |
| How information arrives | Let the anomaly force action, then supply the background needed for that action | Establish character, rules, and relationships, then let the anomaly gradually change their meaning |
| How anticipation continues | Keep intensifying one central emotional question | Let multiple threads of setup and foreshadowing gradually converge |
| How to check pace | Move quickly, with every passage advancing action, pressure, or feedback | Allow a slower build while every passage still serves character, clue, or the protagonist's next decision |

Write one completion statement before choosing:

> After this opening, the question I most want readers to follow is: ____.

If the answer is “Will she open the sealed carriage now?”, the Fanqie-oriented direction fits more closely. If it is “How are this station, the missing brother, and the sealed carriage connected?”, the Qidian-oriented direction fits more closely. This step selects the writing emphasis for the current story. If the genre is still open, use [choosing a fiction genre](/oh-story/choosing-a-genre). Move to [planning a novel opening](/oh-story/novel-opening) when you are ready to design the full opening.

heading.zh: 锁定同一原创梗概，避免比较时偷换故事
heading.en: Lock One Original Premise So the Comparison Stays Fair

body.zh:
下面两套简报共用这份本页原创梗概：

> 即将停运的山城老索道站里，夜班值守员许知微准备完成最后一次闭站。早已断电的维修打印机突然吐出一张工单，签发人是她失踪多年的哥哥。工单要求她在午夜前放行一节封存车厢；监控画面里车厢空无一人，控制台却显示“乘客已登车”。值班规程要求车厢继续锁闭。许知微必须决定先执行规程、查明工单来源，还是接近车厢寻找哥哥留下的线索。

比较时锁定以下事实：主角、哥哥失踪、索道站即将停运、异常工单、午夜期限、封存车厢、监控与控制台互相矛盾，以及规程要求保持锁闭。两版可以调整揭露顺序、场景重心和期待线，不能改换亲属关系、另加幕后组织，或让其中一版提前知道真相。这样得到的差异来自写法方向，而非梗概强弱。
body.en:
Both briefs below use this original premise created for this page:

> An old cableway station in a mountain city is about to shut down. Night operator Xu Zhiwei prepares to close it for the final time. A maintenance printer that has long been disconnected suddenly produces a work order signed with the name of her brother, who disappeared years ago. It instructs her to release a sealed carriage before midnight. The surveillance feed shows an empty carriage, while the control console reads “PASSENGER ABOARD.” Station procedure requires the carriage to remain locked. Xu Zhiwei must decide whether to follow procedure, trace the work order, or approach the carriage in search of a clue her brother left behind.

Lock these facts during the comparison: the protagonist, her missing brother, the station's closure, the anomalous work order, the midnight deadline, the sealed carriage, the contradiction between surveillance and console, and the rule that keeps the carriage locked. The two versions may change reveal order, scene emphasis, and the thread of anticipation. They may not change the family relationship, add a hidden organization to only one version, or let one version know the answer in advance. This keeps the differences focused on writing direction rather than letting them arise because one version was given a stronger premise.

heading.zh: 把同一梗概交给 AI：两套可复制简报
heading.en: Give the Same Premise to the AI: Two Copyable Briefs

body.zh:
先复制共同梗概，再接上其中一套简报。要求 AI 只写方向样稿，方便比较；选定方向后再扩展正式开篇。

### 番茄向：节奏优先，深挖一个核心情绪

> **任务：** 根据共同梗概写一份开头方向样稿。  
> **优先体验：** 节奏优先。让“失踪哥哥可能仍在呼唤她”的冲击与“是否放行封存车厢”的选择立即进入场景。  
> **开场落点：** 从断电打印机吐出工单开始。许知微认出签名后，控制台紧接着显示“乘客已登车”。背景只在她必须做决定时补充。  
> **期待线：** 围绕“她能否承受再次错过哥哥的可能”持续加压。每次出现新信息，都要改变她接近、推迟或拒绝打开车厢的行动。  
> **节奏规则：** 每段至少推动行动、期限、阻力或可见反馈中的一项。暂不展开车站历史、其他失踪案或独立支线。  
> **保留事实：** 监控为空、控制台显示有人、车厢按规程必须锁闭。异常不能直接证明哥哥仍然活着。  
> **交付格式：** 依次给出“方向样稿”“保留的梗概事实”“第一个会产生后果的选择”“一句话说明为何采用节奏优先”。

这套简报让 AI 先抓住强情绪和鲜明异常，再反复把压力压回同一个选择。它适合你希望读者尽快进入事件，并沿着一个核心情绪继续读下去的故事。

### 起点向：代入优先，让多条线索逐步汇合

> **任务：** 根据共同梗概写一份开头方向样稿。  
> **优先体验：** 代入优先。先让读者理解许知微如何完成闭站、她怎样遵守规程，以及哥哥失踪后这份工作为何仍牵动她。  
> **开场落点：** 从她检查站内设备和封存车厢开始。依次留下维修打印机已经断电、车厢必须锁闭、监控与控制台分别承担什么功能等信息，再让异常工单出现。  
> **期待线：** 让打印机、哥哥签名、空监控和“乘客已登车”成为彼此关联的线索。每条铺垫都要帮助读者修正对车站或失踪事件的理解。  
> **节奏规则：** 可以慢热，每段必须建立人物、规则、关系或线索。背景需要回到许知微当前的观察和判断，避免离开现场单独讲述。  
> **保留事实：** 工单只制造联系哥哥的可能，监控与控制台的矛盾尚未解释，规程仍然约束她。  
> **交付格式：** 依次给出“方向样稿”“保留的梗概事实”“第一个会产生后果的选择”“一句话说明为何采用代入优先”。

这套简报允许人物铺垫和较慢进入，同时用多条相关信息维持期待。样稿若出现与主线无关的旧闻、设定说明或新角色，删掉它们，再检查留下的铺垫能否汇向同一异常。
body.en:
Copy the shared premise first, then append one of the briefs below. Ask the AI for a direction sample only, so you can compare the approaches before expanding the selected one into a full opening.

### Fanqie-oriented: prioritize pace and deepen one central emotion

> **Task:** Write an opening-direction sample from the shared premise.  
> **Priority:** Put pace first. Bring the shock that Xu Zhiwei's missing brother may be calling to her and the decision about releasing the sealed carriage into the scene immediately.  
> **Opening focus:** Begin when the disconnected printer produces the work order. As soon as Xu Zhiwei recognizes the signature, let the console display “PASSENGER ABOARD.” Add background only when she needs it to make a decision.  
> **Anticipation:** Keep increasing the pressure around whether she can bear to miss another possible message from her brother. Every new piece of information must change how she approaches, delays, or refuses to open the carriage.  
> **Pacing rule:** Each passage must advance at least one of these: action, deadline, resistance, or visible feedback. Do not expand the station's history, other disappearances, or an independent subplot yet.  
> **Facts to preserve:** Surveillance shows an empty carriage, the console says someone is aboard, and procedure requires the carriage to remain locked. The anomaly cannot prove that her brother is alive.  
> **Output format:** Return “direction sample,” “premise facts preserved,” “first consequential choice,” and “one sentence explaining why this draft uses a pace-first emphasis,” in that order.

This brief asks the AI to lead with a strong emotion and a clear anomaly, then return the pressure to the same choice. It fits a story that should enter the event quickly and carry readers forward through one central emotional question.

### Qidian-oriented: prioritize immersion and let several clues converge

> **Task:** Write an opening-direction sample from the shared premise.  
> **Priority:** Put immersion first. Establish how Xu Zhiwei closes the station, how she follows procedure, and why the job still carries emotional weight after her brother's disappearance.  
> **Opening focus:** Begin with her inspection of the station equipment and sealed carriage. Establish that the maintenance printer is disconnected, that the carriage must remain locked, and that surveillance and the console serve different functions before the anomalous order appears.  
> **Anticipation:** Treat the printer, her brother's signature, the empty surveillance image, and “PASSENGER ABOARD” as related clues. Each setup detail should help readers revise their understanding of the station or the disappearance.  
> **Pacing rule:** A slower build is acceptable, but every passage must establish character, rule, relationship, or clue. Keep background attached to Xu Zhiwei's present observations and judgments rather than leaving the scene for a separate explanation.  
> **Facts to preserve:** The order creates only the possibility of a connection to her brother, the contradiction between surveillance and console remains unexplained, and procedure still constrains her.  
> **Output format:** Return “direction sample,” “premise facts preserved,” “first consequential choice,” and “one sentence explaining why this draft uses an immersion-first emphasis,” in that order.

This brief allows character setup and a slower entry while sustaining anticipation through several related details. If the sample introduces unrelated old cases, standalone lore, or extra characters, remove them and check whether the remaining setup converges on the same anomaly.

heading.zh: 并排检查样稿，然后只保留一个主方向
heading.en: Compare the Samples Side by Side, Then Keep One Main Direction

body.zh:
让两份样稿都回答下面四项，再决定采用哪一版：

| 检查项 | 番茄向样稿应能指出 | 起点向样稿应能指出 |
|---|---|---|
| 开头承诺 | 一个立刻施压的情绪问题和选择 | 一组让人物处境逐渐变得异常的线索 |
| 读者带走的信息 | 当前危机、期限、阻力与主角行动 | 人物习惯、现场规则、线索关系与当前判断 |
| 下一段的推动力 | 选择产生的反馈继续加深核心情绪 | 已有线索之间出现新的连接或矛盾 |
| 需要删掉的内容 | 延缓当前选择的背景与支线 | 无法汇入人物或线索的散乱铺垫 |

选择后，把采用版的“优先体验、期待线、节奏规则、保留事实”放进项目简报，让后续 AI 续写继续服从同一方向。另一版留作比较记录，避免后续段落同时追求即时冲击与大面积慢铺，导致开头承诺来回变化。

本页到此完成与两个平台相关的写作方向选择与 AI 任务定义。需要安排完整开篇的信息顺序和场景时使用[小说开篇设计](/oh-story/novel-opening)；需要把同一方向分配到连载章节时参考[网文节奏](/oh-story/web-serial-pacing)；需要固定个人句式、叙述距离和对白习惯时使用[保留作者文风](/oh-story/preserve-author-voice)。
body.en:
Make both samples answer the four checks below before choosing one:

| Check | The Fanqie-oriented sample should identify | The Qidian-oriented sample should identify |
|---|---|---|
| Opening promise | One emotional question and choice that create immediate pressure | A set of clues that gradually makes the character's situation strange |
| What readers carry forward | The current crisis, deadline, resistance, and protagonist action | Character habits, scene rules, clue relationships, and current judgment |
| What drives the next passage | Feedback from the choice deepens the central emotion | A new connection or contradiction emerges among existing clues |
| What to remove | Background and subplots that delay the current choice | Scattered setup that cannot converge on character or clue |

After choosing, place the accepted brief's priority, anticipation, pacing rule, and locked facts in the project brief so later AI-assisted writing follows the same direction. Keep the other version only as a comparison record. This prevents later passages from switching repeatedly between immediate impact and broad slow setup until the opening promise becomes unclear.

This page stops after defining the writing direction associated with each platform and the AI task. Use [planning a novel opening](/oh-story/novel-opening) when you are ready to arrange the full opening's scenes and information. Consult [web-serial pacing](/oh-story/web-serial-pacing) when distributing the accepted direction across serialized chapters. Use [preserving author voice](/oh-story/preserve-author-voice) to lock sentence habits, narrative distance, and dialogue choices.

q.zh: 番茄和起点哪个好？
q.en: Which is better for my story, Fanqie or Qidian?

a.zh: 想让开头快速交付强情绪、鲜明噱头和立即发生的选择，先试番茄向；想先建立人物处境，让多条铺垫和伏笔逐渐汇合，先试起点向。把同一梗概交给两套简报，选择更接近本书阅读体验的一版。
a.en: Try the Fanqie-oriented brief first when the opening should deliver strong emotion, a clear hook, and an immediate choice. Try the Qidian-oriented brief first when it should establish the character's situation and let multiple threads of setup and foreshadowing converge. Apply both briefs to the same premise, then choose the sample closer to the reading experience intended for the book.

q.zh: 新手写番茄还是起点，最先看什么？
q.en: What should a new writer compare first?

a.zh: 先写清读者读完开头后最想追问的问题。问题指向眼前选择和核心情绪时，先用番茄向；问题指向人物处境、规则和多条线索的关系时，先用起点向。两版继续使用同一梗概，比较结果才会落在写法上。
a.en: Write the question readers should most want answered after the opening. Start with the Fanqie-oriented brief when that question centers on an immediate choice and core emotion. Start with the Qidian-oriented brief when it centers on the character's situation, rules, and relationships among several clues. Keep the premise identical so the comparison stays focused on the writing approach.

q.zh: 可以把两种写法混在一起吗？
q.en: Can I combine the two writing directions?

a.zh: 可以吸收另一方向的局部手法，同时为当前开头保留一个主优先级。采用番茄向时，人物背景要服务眼前选择；采用起点向时，强异常要进入已经建立的线索关系。混合后再次检查读者应持续追问的核心问题是否仍然清楚。
a.en: You can borrow a local technique from the other direction while keeping one main priority for the current opening. In a Fanqie-oriented version, character background should serve the immediate choice. In a Qidian-oriented version, a strong anomaly should enter the clue relationships already being established. After combining them, check that the central question readers should carry forward remains clear.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 里说：“用 /story-long-write 保留这个梗概的既定事实，分别制作番茄向与起点向的开头简报：前者优先节奏、强情绪和单一核心期待，后者优先代入、人物铺垫和多线伏笔；各写一份方向样稿，列出读者带走的信息和下一步期待，等我选择后再扩展。”（Codex 中使用 `$story-long-write`。）
text.en: In Claude Code, say: “Use `/story-long-write` to preserve the established facts of this premise and prepare two opening briefs. The Fanqie-oriented version should prioritize pace, strong emotion, and one central thread of anticipation. The Qidian-oriented version should prioritize immersion, character setup, and multiple threads of foreshadowing. Write one direction sample for each, list what readers carry forward and expect next, and wait for my choice before expanding either version.” In Codex, use `$story-long-write`.

title.zh: 海螺H3提示词怎么写：三段结构、声音分层与参考模式
title.en: How to Write Hailuo H3 Prompts: Structure, Sound, and Reference Modes

seo_title.zh: 海螺H3提示词怎么写｜三段结构
seo_title.en: Hailuo H3 Prompts: Structure, Sound, and References

description.zh: 海螺H3提示词用画面时间线、整体声景、观众专属配乐三段写作；附原创花店单镜示例、参考模式分叉和逐项改法。
description.en: Write Hailuo H3 prompts with a visual timeline, soundscape, and audience-only score. Includes a flower-shop example, mode choices, and fixes.

answer.zh: 海螺H3提示词先用三字段分别写画面时间线、整体声景和观众专属配乐，单镜也从 `[Shot 1]` 开始。输入类型决定是否追加首帧或尾帧对齐说明，或改用 full-reference 六段；中文对白保留原句。
answer.en: Hailuo H3 prompts use three fields for the shot timeline, overall soundscape, and audience-only score; even a single shot begins with `[Shot 1]`. The actual inputs determine whether you add a frame-alignment instruction or switch to the six-section full-reference format. Keep Chinese dialogue verbatim.

heading.zh: 海螺H3三段提示词：画面时间线、声景、配乐
heading.en: The Three H3 Fields: Timeline, Soundscape, and Score

body.zh:
这三个英文段名属于 H3 的结构化提示词格式，不是所有视频模型都通用的“提示词公式”。按以下分工填写：

1. **`integrated_multimodal_description`**：从 `[Shot 1]` 开始，按播放顺序写景别与构图、可见起点、动作变化、说话人、逐字对白、同步发生的声音和可核对的终点。即使只有一个镜头，也写 `[Shot 1]`。
2. **`overall_soundscape`**：用一个连续段落概括全片环境底声、物理动作声和非语言人声，例如雨声、脚步、花盆落桌声或呼吸。不要在这里重复对白。
3. **`non_diegetic_music`**：只写角色听不见、观众能听见的配乐，描述乐器、速度、节奏和音量变化。角色能听见的店内收音机或现场演奏仍属于画面时间线。没有观众专属配乐时写 `N/A`。

声音分层的判断点是“要不要卡在某个动作或发声时刻”：需要精确同步的画内声写在主时间线的对应动作旁；`overall_soundscape` 汇总全片环境声、物理动作声和非语言人声，必要时可以概括时间线上的重要声响，但不要重复对白。

可复制骨架：

```text
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [Style and framing]. [Visible start state]. [Action and visible result; add a timed in-scene sound cue beside its triggering action, if needed]. The [speaker description] (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 逐字台词</d>. [Visible end state].

overall_soundscape: [Summarize the clip-wide ambience, physical sounds, and non-verbal human sounds; do not repeat dialogue].

non_diegetic_music: N/A
```

若需要观众专属配乐，把上一代码块最后一行替换为：

```text
non_diegetic_music: [Audience-only score: instruments, tempo, rhythm, and dynamics]
```

本页沿用 H3 官方英文结构化指南的字段名和示例表达；这是模板格式，不代表英文提示词效果更好，也不代表每个界面都强制要求英文。给说话人一个稳定编号，例如 `(S1)`；身份、音色或动作写在 `<d>` 外，`<d>` 内保留语言标签和实际台词。中文对白写成 `<d>[Chinese] 原句</d>`，逐字保留。详见官方[基础与关键帧提示词指南](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/blob/d21241f0a4b3acbb34c97dae47fa417b7065e438/skills/h3-prompt-writing/references/base-en.txt)。
body.en:
These English field names belong to H3's structured prompt format; they are not a universal formula for every video model. Fill them as follows:

1. **`integrated_multimodal_description`**: Beginning with `[Shot 1]`, describe framing and composition, the visible start state, observable action, speakers, verbatim dialogue, synchronized sound, and a checkable end state in playback order. Keep `[Shot 1]` even when the video contains one shot.
2. **`overall_soundscape`**: In one continuous paragraph, summarize ambience, physical action sounds, and non-verbal human sounds across the video—rain, footsteps, a pot touching a counter, or breathing. Do not repeat dialogue here.
3. **`non_diegetic_music`**: Describe only music that the audience hears and the characters do not, using instrumentation, tempo, rhythm, and changes in volume. A radio or live performance audible inside the scene remains on the main timeline. Write `N/A` when no audience-only score is intended.

The sound-placement test is whether a cue must land on a particular action or vocal beat. Put time-critical diegetic sound beside that action on the main timeline. `overall_soundscape` summarizes ambience, physical sounds, and non-verbal human sounds across the clip; it may briefly recap an important cue, but it should not repeat dialogue.

Copyable skeleton:

```text
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [Style and framing]. [Visible start state]. [Action and visible result; add a timed in-scene sound cue beside its triggering action, if needed]. The [speaker description] (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 逐字台词</d>. [Visible end state].

overall_soundscape: [Summarize clip-wide ambience, physical sounds, and non-verbal human sounds; do not repeat dialogue].

non_diegetic_music: N/A
```

If you want an audience-only score, replace the final line of that block with:

```text
non_diegetic_music: [Audience-only score: instruments, tempo, rhythm, and dynamics]
```

This page follows the English field names and example style of H3's official structured guide. That describes the template; it does not claim English prompts work better or that every interface requires English. Give each speaker a stable ID such as `(S1)`. Put the speaker's identity, voice, or action outside `<d>`; inside `<d>`, preserve the language tag and spoken words. Keep Chinese dialogue verbatim as `<d>[Chinese] original line</d>`. See the official [base and keyframe prompt guide](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/blob/d21241f0a4b3acbb34c97dae47fa417b7065e438/skills/h3-prompt-writing/references/base-en.txt).

heading.zh: 首帧、首尾帧与 full-reference 不是同一种格式
heading.en: First Frames, First-and-Last Frames, and Full Reference Use Different Shapes

body.zh:
先看你实际提交了哪些输入，再选提示词形状。不要先套模板，最后才决定要不要挂参考素材。

| 实际输入 | 使用的结构 | 写作重点 |
|---|---|---|
| 没有图片，明确做文生视频 | 三字段 | 从文字建立完整的可见起点、动作路径和终点 |
| 一张首帧 | 首帧对齐说明 + 三字段 | 从首帧现有姿态、构图和场景继续向前发展 |
| 一张首帧 + 一张尾帧 | 首尾帧对齐说明 + 三字段 | 写两帧之间连续、可观察的动作路径；结尾落到尾帧，不再追加新状态 |
| 只提供一张尾帧（如果所用入口支持） | 尾帧对齐说明 + 三字段 | 从合理的先前状态开始，逐步收束到给定尾帧 |
| 人物、地点、道具等普通参考图，或参考视频、音频；首帧再加其他参考素材也属于此类 | full-reference 六段 | 定义每项真实素材的标签和作用，再写保留关系与详细时间线 |

H3 官方指南也定义了仅尾帧的 L2VA：若当前入口提供这种输入，就加尾帧对齐说明并沿三字段写法，从合理前态收束到尾帧；不同界面或接口提供的模式可能不同。

full-reference 的六段依次是：

```text
subject_definitions: ...
summary: ...
retention_analysis: ...
detailed_description: [Shot 1] ...
overall_soundscape: ...
non_diegetic_music: ...
```

六段是一条完整提示词，不是六次生成，也不能只交其中的 `detailed_description`。`<Picture 1>`、`<Video 1>`、`<Audio 1>` 等标签必须对应这次任务中实际附加的素材；同类素材的编号要和提交顺序一致。只在文字里写“参考人物图”或 `<Picture 1>`，不能替代上传或传入那份文件。具体六段规则见官方[full-reference 提示词指南](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/blob/d21241f0a4b3acbb34c97dae47fa417b7065e438/skills/h3-prompt-writing/references/ref-en.txt)。你实际使用的界面或接口未必展示所有模式，应以可用输入方式为准，不要把缺失的参考素材默默改成文生视频。
body.en:
Choose the prompt shape from the inputs you will actually submit. Do not start from a template and decide whether to attach references afterward.

| Actual inputs | Structure | Writing focus |
|---|---|---|
| No image, with text-to-video intentionally selected | Three fields | Establish the complete visible start, action path, and end in text |
| One first frame | First-frame alignment instruction + three fields | Continue forward from the pose, composition, and scene already present in the first frame |
| One first frame + one last frame | First/last-frame alignment instruction + three fields | Describe an observable continuous path between the two frames; arrive at the last frame without adding a new state afterward |
